a5-alarm-test.text: This is a test of the building fire alarm system. No action is required. Please continue with your normal activities.

a5-alight.text: Attention, shoppers. We're opening register six, so if you're waiting in line, come on over.

a5-behind.text: Ladies and gentlemen, we apologize for the delay. Due to an earlier signal problem, we're running about fifteen minutes behind schedule.

a5-boarding-time.text: Good morning, guests! All-aboard time in Cozumel today is four thirty p.m. The ship sails at five, with or without you!

a5-burst-pipe.text: Thanks for calling Metro Water. Our office is now closed. If you're reporting a burst pipe or a water outage, please stay on the line.

a5-closing.text: Thank you for shopping with us today. The store will be closing in fifteen minutes, at eight p.m. Please bring your final purchases to the registers.

a5-coats.text: Shoppers, for the next thirty minutes only, all winter coats on the third floor are forty percent off.

a5-cover-shift.text: Hey, it's me. Look, I know it's short notice, an' you can totally say no, but is there any chance you could gimme a ride to the airport Saturday mornin'? My flight's at seven. Anyway, text me.

a5-dentist.text: Hi, it's Karen from Bayside Dental, just confirming your appointment on Thursday the fourteenth at three fifteen. Give us a call if you need to change it.

a5-did-you-say.text: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Did you say 'cancel my order'?

a5-final-call.text: This is the final boarding call for passenger Sato on flight two-twelve to Chicago. Please proceed immediately to gate sixty-four.

a5-gate-moved.text: Welcome to the Fox Theater! The opening act goes on at seven thirty, and the headliner takes the stage at about nine fifteen.

a5-high-volume.text: We're currently experiencing a high volume of calls. You may find it quicker to visit our website.

a5-intercom.text: Station office. Have you tried tapping your card again on the yellow reader?

a5-key-code.text: Hey, it's Sam. So Grandma's turning ninety on Sunday! I got the cake, so can ya grab the number candles on your way? Thanks!

a5-last-train.text: This is the last train to Newark this evening. There is no further service tonight.

a5-leave-message.text: Hi, you've reached Doctor Rivera's office. We're closed for lunch until two. Please leave your name, your number and a short message after the tone.

a5-make-known.text: Attention, shoppers. We have a little boy named Leo, about five years old, at Guest Services by the main entrance. He's looking for his mom.

a5-other-side.text: The doors on this side will not open at the next station. Please use the doors on the opposite side.

a5-out-of-service.text: Sorry, buddy, this train's not in service. You'll want the next one, on track two.

a5-passing.text: Parents in the pickup line, please stay in your vehicles. A staff member will walk your child out to you.

a5-plumber.text: Hi, it's Tom from the management office. Just a heads-up, the plumber's runnin' late tomorrow, so if you're hopin' to see him before lunch, I wouldn't hold your breath.

a5-press-three.text: For billing and payments, press one. To report a lost or stolen card, press three. For all other inquiries, please hold.

a5-queue.text: All of our representatives are currently assisting other callers. You are caller number six, and your estimated wait time is twelve minutes.

a5-reason.text: In a few words, please tell me the reason for your call. For example, you can say 'check my balance' or 'report a problem'.

a5-rows.text: At this time, we'd like to invite passengers seated in rows thirty and higher to board. All other passengers, please remain seated.

a5-suspended.text: Due to an accident at Shinjuku, Chuo Line services are suspended between Tokyo and Mitaka. Passengers are advised to use Tokyo Metro services instead.

a5-track.text: Ladies and gentlemen, due to rain, tonight's first pitch has been pushed back from seven-oh-five to seven forty-five. Thanks for your patience!

a5-typhoon.text: A typhoon warning remains in place for Kanto. Expect heavy rain from about two p.m., with gusts of up to ninety kilometers an hour, easing to forty by Thursday morning.

a5-wind.text: May I have your attention, please. The museum will close in twenty minutes. Please make your way to the exits. The gift shop will stay open for another half hour.

call-bag-found-1.text: Hi, this is Dodo Airlines baggage services, callin' about yer missing bag. Good news, we found it. It went to Sapporo by mistake.

call-bag-found-2.text: It'll be on the first flight tomorrow, an' a driver'll drop it off at yer hotel by noon.

call-bag-found-3.text: Great. Do I need a reference number?

call-bag-found-4.text: Yep, it's H, N, D, four-two-oh-seven-five.

call-bag-found-5.text: Oh, sorry, I'm just hearin' the mornin' flight's full, so it'll be the afternoon one. Make that by six p m instead of noon.

call-bag-found-6.text: That's fine. I'll be out, though. Can they leave it at the front desk?

call-bag-found-7.text: Sure thing. Just let the hotel know it's comin', an' you'll need I D ta pick it up.

call-brunch-moved-1.text: Hey! So I finally got everyone together fer brunch. Sunday at eleven, at the Bluebird Café.

call-brunch-moved-3.text: Maple, Goldie, Marshal, an' you, of course. Oh, an' Goldie's bringin' her new boyfriend. I know! Long story short, they met at physical therapy.

call-brunch-moved-4.text: Ha! I can't wait to hear that one.

call-brunch-moved-5.text: Oh, an' a heads-up, Bluebird moved. It's on Fifth Avenue now, across from the library.

call-brunch-moved-6.text: Oh, wait. Maple just texted. She can't do Sunday. So let's make it Saturday, eleven-thirty. Same place.

call-brunch-moved-7.text: Saturday, eleven-thirty, Fifth Avenue. Got it!

call-card-blocked-1.text: Thanks for holdin'. You've reached card services, this is Maple. Can I start with yer date of birth?

call-card-blocked-3.text: Thank you. So I can see we put a hold on yer card this morning. There was a charge from an electronics store in Lisbon, for a hundred eighty-nine euros.

call-card-blocked-4.text: That wasn't me. I've never even been to Portugal.

call-card-blocked-5.text: Okay, so I'll cancel that card an' send ya a new one. It'll go ta yer address in Setagaya, an' it should be there in five ta seven business days.

call-card-blocked-6.text: Oh, sorry, I moved. It's Nakano now. I thought I'd updated it.

call-card-blocked-7.text: Hmm, it's not showin'. Unfortunately, I can't change the address over the phone, so you'd need ta do that in the app first, then call us back an' we'll send the card.

call-clinic-move-1.text: Hi, this is Pashmina from Sunny Clinic, callin' about yer appointment on Friday at nine-thirty.

call-clinic-move-3.text: Dr. Julian's out on Friday, so the soonest we have is Monday at eleven-fifteen. Would that work?

call-clinic-move-5.text: Great. Oh, wait, sorry. I misread that. It's eleven-fifty, not eleven-fifteen.

call-clinic-move-6.text: Eleven-fifty, okay. Should I bring anything?

call-clinic-move-7.text: Jus' yer insurance card. An' please come in ten minutes early ta fill out a form.

call-coat-hold-1.text: Hi, this is Label from Able Sisters. Ya asked about the wool coat in a medium?

call-coat-hold-2.text: Oh, yes! Did it come in?

call-coat-hold-3.text: So, we're all oudda the medium in gray, but we got it in navy. Or there's a large in gray, an' it runs preddy small.

call-coat-hold-4.text: Hmm. I'll take the large in gray, I think.

call-coat-hold-5.text: Perfect. I can hold it for you until Saturday.

call-coat-hold-6.text: Oh, actually, no, sorry. We're closed this Saturday. So, until Friday at six. Is that okay?

call-coat-hold-7.text: Friday at six. That works. Thanks so much!

call-dentist-move-1.text: Hi, this is Francine from Bayside Vet. I'm callin' with Biscuit's blood test results.

call-dentist-move-2.text: So, good news first. His kidneys look totally fine. But he's put on a little weight since spring.

call-dentist-move-3.text: Yeah, my mom keeps giving him treats. What should I do?

call-dentist-move-4.text: Let's cut his food ta half a cup, twice a day. Oh, no, wait, that's what you're givin' him now. Make it a third of a cup.

call-dentist-move-5.text: A third of a cup. Got it.

call-dentist-move-6.text: An' no more than two treats a day. Maybe tell yer mom that part. We'd like ta weigh him again in three months.

call-dinner-six-1.text: Hey! So I booked dinner fer Saturday. Rosa's, the Italian place on Pine Street. Seven-thirty, fer five of us.

call-dinner-six-3.text: You, me, Punchy, Judy an' Kid Cat. Oh, an' Kid Cat's allergic ta nuts, so remind the server, 'cause I'll forget.

call-dinner-six-5.text: Oh, Judy just texted. She's bringin' her sister, so we're six now. An' they can't do six at seven-thirty.

call-dinner-six-6.text: So I moved it ta eight-fifteen. Sorry, I know that's kinda late.

call-doctor-chart-1.text: Hi, this is Pashmina from Dr. Julian's office. I'm callin' about yer prescription an' yer follow-up.

call-doctor-chart-3.text: So, we sent the prescription ta the pharmacy on Main Street. It's one tablet twice a day, fer seven days.

call-doctor-chart-4.text: Okay. And when should I come back?

call-doctor-chart-5.text: He wants ta see you in two weeks. The soonest we have is Thursday the twentieth, at nine-fifteen.

call-doctor-chart-6.text: Oh, sorry, I was lookin' at the wrong chart. Yours is fer ten days, not seven. An' it went to the pharmacy by the station, not Main Street.

call-doctor-chart-7.text: Ten days, the one by the station, and Thursday at nine-fifteen. Got it.

call-dryer-window-1.text: Hi, this is Tammy from Fix-It Appliance, callin' about yer dryer. We've got ya down fer Thursday, between eight an' noon.

call-dryer-window-2.text: Okay. Can you narrow that down at all?

call-dryer-window-3.text: Sorry, that's the window. But I'll have 'im text ya when 'e's on 'is way. An' just so ya know, the visit's eighty-five, but it goes toward the repair.

call-dryer-window-4.text: Got it. Do I need to be home?

call-dryer-window-5.text: Someone over eighteen has to be there, yeah.

call-dryer-window-6.text: Oh, hang on. I'm seein' the part's on back order, so it won't be Thursday. Let's make it Friday, same window.

call-dryer-window-7.text: Friday, eight to noon. That works.

call-film-rebook-1.text: Hey, so, bad news. My train's stuck outside Shinagawa. Some kinda signal problem.

call-film-rebook-2.text: Oh no. The movie starts at seven.

call-film-rebook-3.text: Yeah, I know. I'm not gonna make seven. Is there a later showing, by any chance?

call-film-rebook-5.text: Nine-fifteen... Actually, no, I hafta be up early tomorrow. Could we just do tomorrow at seven instead?

call-film-rebook-6.text: An', um, those recliner seats were kinda pricey, weren't they? Just sayin'.

call-film-rebook-7.text: Ha, okay. Regular seats it is.

call-flea-market-1.text: Hey, it's me. So, about the flea market on Saturday. It's supposed ta rain all day.

call-flea-market-2.text: Oh no. Should we skip it?

call-flea-market-3.text: Nah, let's do Sunday instead. Lemme check the times. Okay, it opens at ten.

call-flea-market-4.text: The line's gonna be crazy, so let's meet at the south exit at nine-thirty.

call-flea-market-5.text: Oh, wait, no. The south exit's closed for construction. Make it the east exit.

call-flea-market-6.text: An' bring cash. A lotta the stalls don't take cards.

call-flea-market-7.text: Got it. Sunday, nine-thirty, east exit, and cash. See you there!

call-gp-callback-1.text: Hi, I'd like to see a doctor today if possible. I've had a fever since last night.

call-gp-callback-2.text: Okay. We don't have any appointments left today, unfortunately, but I c'n put you down for a phone call with the doctor.

call-gp-callback-3.text: She'll call ya sometime between two an' four. What's the best number ta reach you at?

call-gp-callback-7.text: Got it, two-eight-one-six. An' if yer breathing gets worse before then, don't wait for the call. Come right in.

call-gym-cancel-1.text: Hi, I'd like to cancel my gym membership, please.

call-gym-cancel-2.text: Oh, I'm sorry ta hear that! Can I ask why? Is it the price? 'Cause I c'n do three months at half price.

call-gym-cancel-3.text: No, thanks. I'm moving, and there isn't a location near my new place.

call-gym-cancel-4.text: Totally get it. Y'know, we do have a home workout app, though. That's just nine-eighty a month.

call-gym-cancel-5.text: I'm sure it's great, but I'd just like to cancel.

call-gym-cancel-6.text: Of course. So yer last day'll be the thirtieth, an' you'll be charged for this month. Oh, sorry, there's a one-month notice period, so it'll actually be the end of next month.

call-gym-cancel-7.text: Seriously? Fine. Can you email me a confirmation?

call-hama-cake-strawberry-1.text: Hi, this is Sweet Bakery. Your birthday cake is ready.

call-hama-cake-strawberry-2.text: Great! Is it the chocolate cake?

call-hama-cake-strawberry-3.text: Yes, chocolate. Oh, wait. Sorry, yours is the strawberry cake.

call-hama-cake-strawberry-4.text: Right, strawberry. When can I pick it up?

call-hama-cake-strawberry-5.text: Any time today. We're open until seven.

call-hama-cake-strawberry-6.text: And the candles are free. See you soon!

call-hama-haircut-friday-1.text: Hello, this is Hair Studio Mint. It's about your haircut on Thursday.

call-hama-haircut-friday-2.text: I'm sorry. Your stylist is out sick, but she's back on Friday.

call-hama-haircut-friday-3.text: Can you come on Friday at four instead?

call-hama-haircut-friday-5.text: Thank you. It's the same stylist and the same price.

call-hama-hotel-late-1.text: Hi, I have a reservation for tonight. I'll arrive late, at eleven.

call-hama-hotel-late-2.text: That's fine. The front desk is open all night.

call-hama-hotel-late-3.text: Thanks. Is breakfast on the second floor?

call-hama-hotel-late-4.text: Yes, the second floor. Oh, sorry, it's on the first floor now.

call-hama-hotel-late-5.text: Breakfast is from seven to ten.

call-hama-movie-late-1.text: Hi! I'm on the train. I'm a little late.

call-hama-movie-late-2.text: That's okay. The movie starts at six forty.

call-hama-movie-late-3.text: I can be there at six thirty. Can you buy two tickets?

call-hama-movie-late-4.text: Sure. Where do you want to meet?

call-hama-movie-late-5.text: At the front door. No, wait, at the coffee shop next to it.

call-hama-parcel-1.text: Hello, this is City Delivery. I have a package for you.

call-hama-parcel-2.text: Oh, thanks. I'm not home right now.

call-hama-parcel-3.text: No problem. I can come back at four. Sorry, at five.

call-hama-parcel-5.text: Great. It's a small box from Osaka. See you at five.

call-hama-party-ice-1.text: Hi! I'm having a party on Saturday. Can you come?

call-hama-party-ice-3.text: At six. It's at my new place near Ueno Park.

call-hama-party-ice-4.text: Can you bring some cups? Oh, no, I have cups. Bring ice.

call-hama-party-ice-5.text: Ice. No problem. See you Saturday!

call-hama-pharmacy-1.text: Hi, this is Green Pharmacy. Your medicine is ready.

call-hama-pharmacy-3.text: It's thirteen hundred yen. Oh, no, it's one thousand thirty yen. Sorry.

call-hama-pharmacy-5.text: Sure. We close at seven. Please bring your insurance card.

call-hama-post-canada-1.text: Hi. I want to send a small box to Canada.

call-hama-post-canada-2.text: Sure. By air, it takes five days. It's two thousand four hundred yen.

call-hama-post-canada-3.text: Five days is good. Can I pay by card?

call-hama-post-canada-4.text: Yes, you can. Oh, sorry. Not at this branch. It's cash only.

call-hama-post-canada-5.text: Okay, cash is fine. When do you close?

call-hama-post-canada-6.text: At five. Please bring the box before then.

call-hama-table-for-five-1.text: Hi, this is Rossi's. I'm calling about your table on Friday.

call-hama-table-for-five-2.text: It's for four people at seven, right?

call-hama-table-for-five-3.text: Yes. Oh, sorry, it's five people now. My sister is coming.

call-hama-table-for-five-4.text: No problem. Five people at seven.

call-hama-table-for-five-5.text: We have a big table by the window for you.

call-hama-taxi-black-1.text: Hello, this is Blue Taxi. Your car is outside now.

call-hama-taxi-black-3.text: It's white. The number is twenty-eight.

call-hama-taxi-black-4.text: Hmm, I only see a black car.

call-hama-taxi-black-5.text: Oh, sorry. Your car is black. The white car is for someone else.

call-hama-taxi-black-6.text: The driver is waiting at the front door.

call-hama-water-wednesday-1.text: Hello, this is the building office. It's about the water.

call-hama-water-wednesday-2.text: There's no water on Tuesday, from ten to two.

call-hama-water-wednesday-4.text: Oh, sorry. Not Tuesday. The work is on Wednesday.

call-hama-water-wednesday-5.text: Wednesday. Got it. What should I do?

call-hama-water-wednesday-6.text: Please fill some bottles with water before then. Thank you.

call-hama-yoga-towel-1.text: Hi, this is Sunny Gym. Your first yoga class is on Sunday.

call-hama-yoga-towel-2.text: Great. What time does it start?

call-hama-yoga-towel-3.text: At nine. Please come ten minutes early.

call-hama-yoga-towel-4.text: And bring a mat. Oh, wait, we have mats. Just bring a towel.

call-hama-yoga-towel-5.text: Okay. Just a towel. See you on Sunday.

call-handouts-favour-1.text: Hey, it's me. Sorry, I know it's early. So, long story, but my son has a fever, so I'm workin' from home today.

call-handouts-favour-2.text: Oh no, I hope he's okay.

call-handouts-favour-3.text: He'll live. Anyway, the thing is, I was supposta present at the ten o'clock with the Nagoya team.

call-handouts-favour-4.text: Would you mind printin' the handouts? It's the file called Q three final. Twelve copies should do it.

call-handouts-favour-5.text: Actually, make it fifteen. Their manager's joinin', an' she always brings people.

call-handouts-favour-6.text: Oh, an' it's not in Room B anymore. They moved us ta the big one on the fourth floor. I'll call in.

call-handouts-favour-7.text: No problem, I'll take care of it.

call-hoshi-camera-claim-1.text: Thanks for calling Atlas Travel Insurance, this is Walker. I've pulled up your policy. You're calling about the camera, I take it?

call-hoshi-camera-claim-2.text: Yes. It was stolen from a café in Barcelona on the last day of my trip.

call-hoshi-camera-claim-3.text: Sorry to hear that. For theft, we'll need a police report filed locally, not one from back home, plus proof of purchase.

call-hoshi-camera-claim-4.text: I did file a report there. The receipt might be harder to find, though. I bought it about four years ago.

call-hoshi-camera-claim-5.text: A bank statement's fine. Just bear in mind that for anything over three years old, we pay depreciated value, not replacement cost.

call-hoshi-camera-claim-6.text: So I'd get less than what a new one costs.

call-hoshi-camera-claim-7.text: Considerably less, in all likelihood. Your deductible is ten thousand yen, and claims have to be in within thirty days of the loss.

call-hoshi-camera-claim-8.text: Sorry, let me clarify that: thirty days from when you got home, so you actually have until the twenty-eighth.

call-hoshi-camera-claim-9.text: And between you and me, the sooner it's in, the fewer follow-up questions you tend to get.

call-hoshi-customs-scam-1.text: Hi, this is Ryan with Sky Express. I'm calling about an international package that's being held at customs under your name.

call-hoshi-customs-scam-2.text: Held at customs? I'm not expecting anything from overseas.

call-hoshi-customs-scam-3.text: It's listed as a gift, so the sender's details are withheld. That happens a lot this time of year.

call-hoshi-customs-scam-4.text: To release it, there's an import duty of three thousand nine hundred eighty yen, and it has to be settled within two hours, or the package is sent back.

call-hoshi-customs-scam-5.text: Two hours? Can't I just pay when it's delivered?

call-hoshi-customs-scam-6.text: Customs doesn't allow cash on delivery, unfortunately. The quickest way is prepaid cards from any convenience store. You'd just read me the numbers on the back.

call-hoshi-customs-scam-7.text: Oh, I misread that. The total is actually five thousand one hundred eighty yen, because there's also a twelve hundred yen storage fee.

call-hoshi-customs-scam-8.text: What's the tracking number? I'd like to look it up myself.

call-hoshi-customs-scam-9.text: I can't give that out over the phone, for security reasons. But I'd hate for you to lose a gift over a few thousand yen.

call-hoshi-day-pass-1.text: Hi. I'm flying to Vancouver on Friday, and I'd like to avoid a surprise bill like last time.

call-hoshi-day-pass-2.text: Sure thing. The simplest option is the day pass: fifteen hundred yen for any day you use data, calls or texts.

call-hoshi-day-pass-3.text: And on days I don't use it?

call-hoshi-day-pass-4.text: Then you're not charged. The catch is that "use" includes anything running in the background, so an app quietly syncing your photos would count.

call-hoshi-day-pass-5.text: So in practice, it could end up being every day.

call-hoshi-day-pass-6.text: It could. Alternatively, there's a monthly plan at six thousand yen. After fifteen gigs, your speed's throttled rather than billed.

call-hoshi-day-pass-7.text: I'm only there for four days, so it's pretty close either way.

call-hoshi-day-pass-8.text: Correction, sorry: the monthly plan only covers the US, not Canada. So for you, it'd have to be the day pass.

call-hoshi-day-pass-9.text: And if I were you, I'd take a look at which apps you've let refresh in the background before you board.

call-hoshi-dentist-crown-1.text: Bayview Dental, this is Portia speaking. How can I help?

call-hoshi-dentist-crown-10.text: Got it. And since your temporary crown has to last until then, I'd go easy on anything chewy in the meantime.

call-hoshi-dentist-crown-2.text: Hi, I have an appointment tomorrow at ten to get my crown put on, and I need to move it. A work trip came up.

call-hoshi-dentist-crown-3.text: Let me pull that up. I should let you know we normally charge a fifty-dollar fee for changes with less than twenty-four hours' notice.

call-hoshi-dentist-crown-5.text: Officially, yes. That said, you've never canceled on us before, so I can probably get it waived. I just can't promise anything until the office manager signs off.

call-hoshi-dentist-crown-6.text: As for openings, I have the ninth at three fifteen, or the twelfth, first thing in the morning.

call-hoshi-dentist-crown-8.text: Oh, hold on. The doctor's in surgery all day on the twelfth, so that's out after all. It would have to be the ninth.

call-hoshi-dentist-crown-9.text: Okay, the ninth at three fifteen, then.

call-hoshi-fiber-cancel-1.text: Thanks for holding. I understand you're looking to cancel your fiber service. Can I ask what's prompting the change?

call-hoshi-fiber-cancel-2.text: I'm moving overseas at the end of the month, so there's nothing to switch to.

call-hoshi-fiber-cancel-3.text: Got it. I don't suppose a three-month pause would work? We can freeze the account at no charge, and you'd keep your current rate.

call-hoshi-fiber-cancel-4.text: I'll be away for at least two years, so no.

call-hoshi-fiber-cancel-5.text: Fair enough. You're eight months shy of the end of your contract, so there is an early termination fee. It's prorated, which brings it to nine thousand six hundred yen.

call-hoshi-fiber-cancel-6.text: Okay. And what do I do with the router?

call-hoshi-fiber-cancel-7.text: We'll send a prepaid box. If it isn't back within fourteen days, we bill you fifteen thousand yen for the equipment.

call-hoshi-fiber-cancel-8.text: Scratch that. Fourteen days is for the older modems. Yours is the newer model, so it's ten days.

call-hoshi-fiber-cancel-9.text: And I'd hang on to the shipping receipt, if I were you. A few of these have gone missing on the way back.

call-hoshi-flight-moved-up-1.text: Hello, this is Marina with Pacific Air, calling about a schedule change on your flight to Honolulu next Thursday.

call-hoshi-flight-moved-up-2.text: Your departure has been moved up from nine forty p.m. to four fifty-five p.m. Everything else on the booking stays the same.

call-hoshi-flight-moved-up-3.text: Moved up? I'm working until five that day. There's no way I can make that.

call-hoshi-flight-moved-up-4.text: Understood. Because the change is over three hours, you're eligible for a free rebooking or a full refund to your original form of payment.

call-hoshi-flight-moved-up-5.text: What's the next flight after that one?

call-hoshi-flight-moved-up-6.text: Friday at ten fifteen a.m. There's a later one at nine that night, but it's waitlisted, and frankly, I wouldn't hold my breath.

call-hoshi-flight-moved-up-7.text: Friday morning, then. What about the hotel I've booked for Thursday night?

call-hoshi-flight-moved-up-8.text: That I'm afraid we can't cover, since the change wasn't... actually, no, I spoke too soon. Schedule changes are on us, so we'll reimburse one night, up to a hundred and fifty dollars, with a receipt.

call-hoshi-hotel-walked-1.text: Good afternoon, this is Henry at the Harborview. I'm calling about your reservation for tomorrow night.

call-hoshi-hotel-walked-2.text: We've had a plumbing issue on two floors, and as a result we're oversold. So, the short version is we won't be able to accommodate you here.

call-hoshi-hotel-walked-3.text: Oh, no. So where does that leave me?

call-hoshi-hotel-walked-4.text: We've reserved a comparable room at our sister property, the Bayside, at no extra cost, and we'll cover your cab from the airport.

call-hoshi-hotel-walked-5.text: Is it far? I picked your hotel because it's close to the convention center.

call-hoshi-hotel-walked-6.text: It's a bit further out, about twenty minutes on foot from the convention center, but it's right by the light rail.

call-hoshi-hotel-walked-7.text: We'll also take ten percent off your stay... Actually, let me correct that — your first night is complimentary, on us.

call-hoshi-hotel-walked-8.text: Okay. And if a room becomes available there after all?

call-hoshi-hotel-walked-9.text: I can't promise anything, but I'll put a note on your file, and if something frees up for your second night, we'll move you back.

call-hoshi-lease-cat-1.text: Good news on the place in Nakameguro: the owner's accepted your application, and they're even willing to waive the key money.

call-hoshi-lease-cat-2.text: Oh, great. So what do I need to pay up front?

call-hoshi-lease-cat-3.text: One month's deposit, the first month's rent, and our agency fee, which is half a month. So two and a half months in all.

call-hoshi-lease-cat-4.text: And the rent's still a hundred and forty-two thousand yen?

call-hoshi-lease-cat-5.text: It is. One thing, though: it's a two-year lease, and if you break it in the first year, there's a penalty of one month's rent.

call-hoshi-lease-cat-6.text: That should be fine. Oh, and I did mention my cat, right?

call-hoshi-lease-cat-7.text: You did. The owner's position is that pets are "considered case by case," which, in my experience, is a polite way of saying no.

call-hoshi-lease-cat-8.text: Oh, wait, I need to correct something. Our fee is a full month, not half. I had a different listing in my head.

call-hoshi-movers-extras-1.text: Hi, it's Maple from Sunrise Movers, following up on your quote. The base price for the twenty-second is eighty-six thousand yen.

call-hoshi-movers-extras-2.text: Okay, that's about what I expected.

call-hoshi-movers-extras-3.text: Now, that assumes the building has an elevator we can reserve. If we're carrying everything down the stairs, there's a surcharge.

call-hoshi-movers-extras-4.text: There's an elevator, but it's tiny. The sofa won't fit.

call-hoshi-movers-extras-5.text: Then the sofa would likely need to be hoisted out the window, which runs fifteen thousand yen, weather permitting.

call-hoshi-movers-extras-7.text: We'd reschedule that item, which, honestly, isn't ideal for anyone. If you're flexible, the twenty-third is eight thousand yen cheaper, and it's looking clear.

call-hoshi-movers-extras-8.text: The twenty-third works. Let's do that.

call-hoshi-rental-oneway-1.text: Thanks for calling Coastline Rentals, this is Diana. I see a pickup in San Diego on the fourteenth. How can I help?

call-hoshi-rental-oneway-2.text: Hi. Could I push that back a day, to the fifteenth, and drop the car off in L A instead?

call-hoshi-rental-oneway-3.text: The fifteenth is no problem. One-way is doable, though I should mention there's a drop fee, usually around seventy-five dollars.

call-hoshi-rental-oneway-4.text: And for one-way rentals, the hold on your card goes up from two hundred to five hundred dollars, released once the car's checked in.

call-hoshi-rental-oneway-5.text: Five hundred? That's a lot to have tied up during a trip.

call-hoshi-rental-oneway-6.text: I hear you. If you added our full coverage, we could waive the higher hold. That's twenty-eight dollars a day.

call-hoshi-rental-oneway-7.text: My credit card covers rental cars, I think.

call-hoshi-rental-oneway-8.text: A lot of them do. Some exclude one-way rentals, so it might be worth double-checking before you decline it at the counter.

call-hoshi-rental-oneway-9.text: Oh, and I misspoke earlier. The drop fee into L A specifically is ninety-five dollars, not seventy-five. My apologies.

call-hoshi-show-postponed-1.text: Hi, this is the Lyric Theater box office, calling about your tickets for the eighteenth. Unfortunately, the performance has been postponed due to a cast illness.

call-hoshi-show-postponed-2.text: Oh, that's a shame. What happens to my tickets?

call-hoshi-show-postponed-3.text: They carry over automatically to the new date, which is the second of next month, same seats.

call-hoshi-show-postponed-4.text: I'm actually away that week. Could I get my money back instead?

call-hoshi-show-postponed-5.text: You can, but refunds have to go through wherever you bought them, and the window closes seven days from today.

call-hoshi-show-postponed-6.text: I got them on a resale site.

call-hoshi-show-postponed-7.text: Ah. Then it's really between you and the site. I'd be surprised if they were quick about it, so I wouldn't leave it until the last minute.

call-hoshi-show-postponed-8.text: Oh, and I should correct myself. On the second, it's the same section, but not necessarily the same seats.

call-hoshi-water-heater-1.text: Hey, it's CJ from Rapid Plumbing. I'm down in your building's basement, so bear with me. The short answer is it's... and that's the whole problem.

call-hoshi-water-heater-2.text: Sorry, you cut out there. What's the problem?

call-hoshi-water-heater-3.text: The thermostat. Parts and labor come to about eighteen thousand yen, and I could have it done by Thursday.

call-hoshi-water-heater-4.text: Thing is, the unit's fourteen years old. Most of these are built to last ten, twelve years, so honestly, it's living on borrowed time.

call-hoshi-water-heater-5.text: And what would a new one run me?

call-hoshi-water-heater-6.text: Installed, around two hundred forty thousand yen. I know, it's not what anybody wants to hear.

call-hoshi-water-heater-7.text: That's a lot. Let me think it over.

call-hoshi-water-heater-8.text: Sure. If you go with the repair, the part's only under warranty for ninety days... No, wait — that's for refurbished parts. A new thermostat's covered for a year.

call-host-parking-1.text: Hi! It's Daisy, yer host. Just callin' ta walk ya through check-in, since I won't be there.

call-host-parking-2.text: So the lockbox is on the front porch, an' you've got one parking spot out back. It's number fourteen.

call-host-parking-4.text: Oh, wait, no, fourteen is my neighbor's. Sorry! Yours is forty. Four-oh.

call-host-parking-5.text: An' the A C's kinda temperamental. If it beeps, just... unplug... an' you'll...

call-host-parking-6.text: Sorry, you're breaking up. What do I do if it beeps?

call-host-parking-7.text: Sorry, I'm on the train! Just unplug it an' plug it back in. Works every time.

call-hotel-extra-night-1.text: Hi, I have a reservation for tomorrow night, under Wei. I was wondering if I could add a second night.

call-hotel-extra-night-2.text: Lemme take a look. So that's arrivin' on the twelfth... yes, I can add two nights, so you'd check out on the fifteenth.

call-hotel-extra-night-3.text: Sorry, just one more night. So checking out on the fourteenth.

call-hotel-extra-night-4.text: Of course, my mistake. Two nights total, checkin' out on the fourteenth.

call-hotel-extra-night-5.text: The second night's a little more, since it's a Friday. It'd be twenty-two thousand yen instead of eighteen.

call-hotel-extra-night-6.text: That's fine. Oh, and I'm getting in pretty late, maybe around eleven.

call-hotel-extra-night-7.text: No problem at all. The front desk is open twenty-four hours, so just give yer name when you arrive.

call-housewarming-1.text: Hey! I just saw your invite for Saturday. Your new place! I'm so excited.

call-housewarming-3.text: Count me in! But I've got a work thing till eight, so I'll be a liddle late.

call-housewarming-4.text: Kicks is gonna pass, though. He's got a cold.

call-housewarming-5.text: Oh, I'll bring dessert. Actually, no, you said someone's bringing a cake, right? So I'll bring drinks.

call-housewarming-7.text: See you then! Anyway, I'll let you go. Bye!

call-installer-signal-1.text: Hi, this is Spoke an' Chain, callin' about yer bike. So the back wheel's... an' that's why it keeps clickin'.

call-installer-signal-2.text: Sorry, you broke up there. What's wrong with the back wheel?

call-installer-signal-3.text: It's bent. A new wheel's nine thousand yen, plus two thousand for labor.

call-installer-signal-4.text: Okay. When would it be ready?

call-installer-signal-5.text: Friday. Oh, wait, the brake pads are almost gone, too. That's another three thousand, so fourteen thousand total.

call-installer-signal-7.text: Will do. An' bring yer lock key on Friday. Last week we hadta cut someone's lock, an' nobody enjoyed that.

call-jacket-exchange-1.text: Hi, I ordered a jacket online last week, but it's too small. Can I exchange it for a large?

call-jacket-exchange-2.text: Sure! Lemme just pull up yer order. Okay, the navy one, size medium?

call-jacket-exchange-4.text: So we're outta navy in a large, unfortunately. We do have it in olive or charcoal.

call-jacket-exchange-6.text: Great. Return shipping is free, so just send the medium back with the label in the box. Oh, wait. That jacket was on sale, wasn't it? Sale exchanges hafta be mailed within seven days, so get it in the mail by Friday.

call-jacket-exchange-7.text: Okay, I'll drop it off tomorrow.

call-leak-again-1.text: Hey, Tom, I'm at the station. Which exit do I take for your place?

call-leak-again-2.text: Oh, hey! Take the north exit an' go straight, past the convenience store.

call-leak-again-3.text: North exit, past the convenience store. Okay.

call-leak-again-4.text: Wait, no, the east exit. The north one's closed for construction this month. Sorry!

call-leak-again-5.text: Then it's the second left, an' we're the gray building, three C. Oh, an' couldja grab some ice? We kinda underestimated.

call-leak-again-6.text: Sure. East exit, second left, three C, and ice.

call-leak-again-7.text: You're a lifesaver. The buzzer's broken, so just text me when you're downstairs.

call-matinee-meet-1.text: Dude, bad news an' good news. Saturday night sold out in, like, two minutes.

call-matinee-meet-2.text: Oh, no! So what's the good news?

call-matinee-meet-3.text: I got us two fer the Sunday matinee, at two. Row G, seats fourteen an' fifteen. Let's meet out front at one-thirty.

call-matinee-meet-4.text: Nice! Do we pick them up at will call?

call-matinee-meet-5.text: Nope, they're on my phone. I'll text ya yours. They were sixty-five each, plus fees, so ya owe me seventy-two.

call-matinee-meet-6.text: Actually, no, make it one-fifteen out front. The line's gonna be crazy, an' there's a bag check.

call-matinee-meet-7.text: One-fifteen out front. See you Sunday!

call-missed-connection-1.text: Okay, so you've missed the connection ta Haneda. I've got three options for ya.

call-missed-connection-2.text: There's a direct flight tonight at nine fifty, but it's economy only, an' the only seats left are middle seats.

call-missed-connection-3.text: Or tomorrow morning at seven ten, via Seoul. That gets in about three hours later, but we'd put ya up in a hotel tonight.

call-missed-connection-4.text: Or tomorrow at noon, direct, in business. That one's an upgrade, but you'd be payin' for yer own hotel.

call-missed-connection-5.text: I need to be in Tokyo by Thursday evening. Which one's the safest?

call-missed-connection-6.text: Honestly? Tonight's. Oh, wait, scratch that. It just came up as canceled. Then I'd say the seven ten.

call-missed-connection-7.text: Okay, the seven ten, then. With the hotel.

call-moving-quote-1.text: Hi, this is Zucker from Swift Movers, followin' up on yer quote. So for a one-bedroom, Nakano to Kichijoji, we're lookin' at sixty-five thousand.

call-moving-quote-3.text: Great. Now, that's assumin' there's an elevator at both ends. Is there?

call-moving-quote-4.text: Not at the new place. It's on the third floor.

call-moving-quote-5.text: Ah, okay. Stairs are an extra eight thousand a floor after the first, so that's another sixteen.

call-moving-quote-6.text: An' you said the twenty-second, right? That's a Saturday, so add ten percent. Actually, hang on, you said the twenty-first. Friday. No weekend rate, then.

call-moving-quote-7.text: Right, the twenty-first. So what's the total?

call-neighbor-cat-1.text: Hey, it's Tom from nex' door. Sorry ta call so late. I hay' ta ask, but my flight's delayed till tomorrow.

call-neighbor-cat-2.text: Oh, no! What do you need?

call-neighbor-cat-3.text: Wouldja mind feedin' Mochi tonight? Jus' half a can. She gets the fish one, not the chicken.

call-neighbor-cat-4.text: Sure, no problem. How do I get in?

call-neighbor-cat-5.text: The spare key's under the mat. Oh, wait, no. I moved it. It's in the flower pot by the door, the blue one.

call-neighbor-cat-6.text: An' jus' so ya know, she'll act super hungry, but don't give 'er more. She's on a diet.

call-neighbor-cat-7.text: Ha! Got it. Half a can of fish, blue flower pot.

call-next-friday-1.text: Hey, quick question. Did you book the restaurant for next Friday?

call-next-friday-2.text: Yeah, for this Friday, the twelfth.

call-next-friday-3.text: Oh. No, I meant next Friday, as in the nineteenth. This Friday's my work thing.

call-next-friday-5.text: Thanks. An' couldja make it seven-thirty instead of seven? I won't get outta the office till six-thirty.

call-next-friday-6.text: Oh, an' it's a pretty fancy place, right? Just so ya know.

call-parcel-express-1.text: Hi, I'd like to send a package to Chicago. It's about three kilos.

call-parcel-express-2.text: Sure. There are three options. Economy's about three weeks, an' that comes to four thousand two hundred yen.

call-parcel-express-3.text: Standard's a week to ten days, for six thousand eight hundred. Express is three days, but that's eleven thousand.

call-parcel-express-4.text: Standard, please. It's a birthday present, so it needs to get there by the twentieth.

call-parcel-express-5.text: Oh. Today's the fourteenth, so standard might be cuttin' it close. Honestly, I'd go express.

call-parcel-express-7.text: Great. An' it'll need a customs form, since it's goin' overseas. Just list what's inside an' roughly what it's worth.

call-pizza-order-1.text: Hi, this is Tangy from Slice House. I'm callin' about yer pickup order, the large veggie an' the garlic knots?

call-pizza-order-2.text: Yes, that's me. Is everything okay?

call-pizza-order-3.text: So, we're all outta mushrooms tonight. Can we do green peppers instead, or wouldja rather skip 'em?

call-pizza-order-5.text: Great. The knots come with marinara, an' ranch is a dollar extra, if ya want it.

call-pizza-order-6.text: Oh, an' sorry, I had the time wrong. It won't be ready at seven-fifteen. It'll be more like seven-forty. The oven's backed up.

call-pizza-order-7.text: Seven-forty. Got it. See you then.

call-plus-one-1.text: Hey, it's Marshal. Quick question about yer party on Saturday. Is it cool if I bring a friend?

call-plus-one-3.text: His name's Kenji. We went to college together. He just moved back to Tokyo.

call-plus-one-4.text: You'll love 'im. He's super inta board games, just like you.

call-plus-one-5.text: Oh, and he's vegetarian. Actually, no, sorry, he's vegan. So no cheese or eggs.

call-plus-one-7.text: Great. We'll be there around seven. Talk soon!

call-prescription-ready-1.text: Hi, this is Tia from Rosa's Kitchen. I'm just callin' ta confirm yer table for Saturday at seven-thirty, for six people.

call-prescription-ready-2.text: Yes, that's right. Oh, and one of us has a peanut allergy.

call-prescription-ready-3.text: No problem, I'll put it on the reservation. Most of the menu's fine. Just skip the satay and the brownie.

call-prescription-ready-4.text: Oh, wait, sorry, I see a note here. You called back an' made it eight, right? So that's eight people.

call-prescription-ready-5.text: Oh, right! Eight. My cousins are coming.

call-prescription-ready-6.text: Great. An' just so ya know, for eight or more, a twenty percent tip is added to the check.

call-redelivery-1.text: Hi, this is the driver with yer delivery. I've gotta package for ya, but nobody's home.

call-redelivery-2.text: Oh, sorry, I'm at work. Could you leave it at the door?

call-redelivery-3.text: Can't, sorry. It needs a signature. I c'n swing by again this evening, though, between six an' eight.

call-redelivery-4.text: Hmm, I won't be back till seven-ish.

call-redelivery-5.text: No problem. Hang on, lemme check... Yeah, I c'n do the last slot instead, eight ta nine.

call-redelivery-6.text: Or if it's easier, yer neighbor in five B said she's happy ta take it.

call-redelivery-7.text: Eight to nine is perfect. Thanks.

call-roaming-refund-1.text: Hi, you've reached roaming support. I understand you've been transferred a couple of times, so I apologize for that.

call-roaming-refund-2.text: That's okay. I was charged twenty-three thousand yen for data in Seoul, but I had the travel pass.

call-roaming-refund-3.text: Okay, lemme take a look. So the pass was active from the third, but you landed on the second, an' it's that first day that got charged.

call-roaming-refund-4.text: But I bought it before I flew.

call-roaming-refund-5.text: You did, yes, but it starts at midnight Japan time. Unfortunately, that's in the terms.

call-roaming-refund-6.text: What I can do, as a one-time courtesy, is take off half. So that'd be eleven thousand five hundred. Actually, lemme just credit the whole thing, since you've been bounced around twice.

call-roaming-refund-7.text: Oh! That's really nice of you. Thank you.

call-screen-ready-1.text: Hi, this is Kid Cat from the phone store on Elm Street. Your phone's ready. New screen, all done.

call-screen-ready-2.text: Oh, great! How much do I owe you?

call-screen-ready-3.text: Ya can pick it up anytime after five today. The screen's a hundred twenty-nine, but yer insurance covers most of it, so ya just pay the twenty-nine-dollar deductible.

call-screen-ready-4.text: Perfect. Do I need to bring anything?

call-screen-ready-5.text: You'd hafta bring a photo I D, since the phone's under yer name.

call-screen-ready-6.text: Oh, wait, sorry. It's Sunday, so we close at five. Come by before four-thirty, 'kay?

call-screen-ready-7.text: Before four-thirty, with my ID. Got it.

call-taco-night-1.text: Hey, are ya still at the station? Couldja grab a couple of things on yer way home?

call-taco-night-3.text: Tortillas, the corn ones, a jar of salsa, an' a dozen eggs.

call-taco-night-4.text: Corn tortillas, salsa, a dozen eggs. Got it.

call-taco-night-5.text: Oh, actually, make that two jars. Ken an' Mari are comin' over Sunday for taco night, an' they go through it like water.

call-taco-night-6.text: An' if they're outta medium, mild is fine. Just not the hot one.

call-wedding-weekend-1.text: Hey, it's Diana! Quick weddin' stuff. You're comin' to the rehearsal dinner Friday, right? It's at seven, at Luigi's.

call-wedding-weekend-2.text: Yep, I'll be there. What should I wear on Saturday?

call-wedding-weekend-3.text: Cocktail attire. Oh, an' the shuttle to the ceremony leaves from the hotel lobby at three-fifteen. It won't wait, so don't be late.

call-wedding-weekend-4.text: Three-fifteen, the lobby. Got it. Should I bring anything?

call-wedding-weekend-5.text: Nope. If ya wanna get 'em somethin', just use the registry. They'll ship it to the house.

call-wedding-weekend-6.text: Oh, wait, sorry. Molly just texted me. The rehearsal dinner's at six-thirty now, not seven. Her parents've got an early flight.

call-wedding-weekend-7.text: Six-thirty at Luigi's. See you Friday!

cu-biscuit-1.text: So, long story short, I adopted a dog. His name's Biscuit.

cu-biscuit-2.text: Stop! I need pictures. What kind?

cu-biscuit-3.text: A beagle. Well, half beagle. The shelter said beagle, but the vet thinks he's mostly basset hound.

cu-biscuit-4.text: Ha! Either way, I love him already.

cu-boulder-1.text: Whatever happened with Whitney? Didn' she move?

cu-boulder-2.text: Yeah, to Denver. Wait, no, Boulder. It's close to Denver. She got a job at the university.

cu-boulder-3.text: Good for her! Does she like it?

cu-boulder-4.text: She loves it, but she says she misses the ocean.

cu-car-next-1.text: Whatever happened with yer car? Didja get it fixed?

cu-car-next-2.text: Ugh, no. Long story short, it wasn't worth fixing. I sold it.

cu-car-next-3.text: Oh, man. That sounds rough. So how're ya gettin' around?

cu-catch-me-up-1.text: Sorry I'm late! Okay, catch me up. What'd I miss?

cu-catch-me-up-2.text: Goldie broke her wrist skiing, and Maple quit her job.

cu-catch-me-up-3.text: Wait, what? Goldie broke her wrist? That sounds so rough. And Maple quit? She loved that job!

cu-fast-july-1.text: Okay, so, my brother's gettin' married in June. No, July. July fourth weekend, which, I know, is crazy.

cu-fast-july-2.text: Wait, back up. Your brother? Whatever happened with the never-getting-married thing?

cu-fast-july-3.text: Ha! Long story short, he met someone at a wedding, of all places.

cu-fast-m-boss.text: So I'm at the airport, I mean, the train station, an' guess who's on my train? My old boss. Fer four hours.

cu-fast-m-run.text: Anyway, I've gotta run, but text me, an' catch me up properly soon. I want the whole story.

cu-fast-n-boulder.text: Boulder's like twenty minutes from Denver. Well, forty with traffic. Actually, no, more like an hour on a bad day.

cu-fast-r-promotion.text: Dude, I got the promotion! They told me, like, this mornin'!

cu-fast-second-1.text: We should do this more often. Like, every month?

cu-fast-second-2.text: Totally. How about the first Saturday of every month?

cu-fast-second-3.text: First Saturday's tough fer me. What about the second? Would that work?

cu-m-back-up.text: Wait, back up. You're movin'? Since when?

cu-m-better-now.text: Honestly, it's been a rough few months. But I'm doin' a lot better now.

cu-m-broke-up.text: Long story short, we broke up, but we're still friends. It's actually fine.

cu-m-kicks.text: You'll never guess who's getting married. Kicks! I know, right?

cu-m-raise.text: You finally asked fer a raise? Good for you! I'm so proud of ya.

cu-n-cast.text: Okay, lemme catch ya up. The cast comes off in six weeks. Sorry, I meant four. The doctor said four last time.

cu-n-moved-in.text: I moved in on the thirteenth. Sorry, I meant the thirtieth. It was the very end of the month.

cu-n-ten-years.text: We met, what, eight years ago? Actually, no, it was twenty sixteen, so ten years.

cu-r-half.text: I finally finished my first half marathon!

cu-r-landlord.text: My landlord's sellin' the building, so I hafta move out by March.

cu-r-ran-into.text: Okay, you'll never guess who I ran inta yesterday.

cu-w-cousin.text: Her brother, I mean, her cousin, lives in Boulder.

cu-w-long-story.text: Long story short, I sold it.

cu-wrist-next-1.text: So I went skiin', broke my wrist, an' then my flight got canceled.

cu-wrist-next-2.text: Wait, back up. You broke your wrist?

cu-wrist-next-3.text: Yeah! Day one. On the bunny hill.

cu-yoga-1.text: Maple! Oh my gosh, how ya been? It's been, what, a year?

cu-yoga-2.text: More! Okay, you'll never guess. I quit the bank.

cu-yoga-3.text: No way! What are you doing now?

cu-yoga-4.text: Long story short, I'm teaching yoga. Full-time. And I've never been happier.

d4-bank-scam-1.text: Hi, this is Mark from your bank's fraud team. We've blocked a suspicious payment.

d4-bank-scam-3.text: I'll explain in a sec. First, just read me the code we texted you, to confirm it's you.

d4-bank-scam-4.text: Hang on. I'll call the number on the back of my card.

d4-cough-drive-1.text: Do you have a paint that'll cover dark red? We're going white.

d4-cough-drive-2.text: This one covers well, but it takes two coats. Are you doing it this weekend?

d4-cough-drive-3.text: Yeah, my in-laws are staying with us on Sunday, actually.

d4-ferry-off-1.text: Is the four o'clock ferry still going? It's pretty windy out there.

d4-ferry-off-2.text: Afraid not, it's been called off. The next one's at six, weather permitting.

d4-ferry-off-3.text: And if that one's canceled too?

d4-friend-cancels-1.text: Hey, so... about tonight. I'm really sorry, but I'm totally wiped out.

d4-friend-cancels-3.text: The worst. Can we do Saturday instead? My treat.

d4-gate-change-1.text: Is this the gate for Seattle?

d4-gate-change-2.text: It was, but it's moved to fifty-two. And there's a forty-minute delay.

d4-gate-change-3.text: Forty? I've got a connection at six-thirty.

d4-gate-change-4.text: You should be fine. They're holding it for everyone on this flight.

d4-grab-lunch-2.text: Good, thanks! Pretty quiet. We finally tried that ramen place on Fifth.

d4-grab-lunch-3.text: Oh, nice! We should grab lunch there sometime.

d4-hotel-suite-1.text: Your room won't be ready till three, I'm afraid.

d4-hotel-suite-2.text: Ah. My meeting's at two, so I was hoping to change first.

d4-hotel-suite-3.text: We do have a suite available now, for a small fee.

d4-im-easy-2.text: Oh, I'm easy. Whatever you want.

d4-im-easy-3.text: Great. How about the ballgame on Saturday, then?

d4-im-easy-4.text: Hmm... we went to a game last weekend.

d4-installer-1.text: So, I can walk Max at noon on weekdays, but I've got class on Tuesdays.

d4-installer-2.text: Tuesdays? That's my late night at the office.

d4-installer-3.text: My sister covers for me. She's great with dogs, just kinda chatty.

d4-installer-4.text: Ha, okay. As long as Max gets his walk.

d4-landlord-1.text: Hi, it's Bunnie on Oak Street. The steps on the deck are wobbly again.

d4-landlord-2.text: Ah. Well, they should be fine for now. Just take it slow on the way down.

d4-landlord-3.text: That's what you said in May.

d4-landlord-4.text: Right, right. I'll, uh, have my guy call you once the lumber comes in.

d4-meeting-room-1.text: Are you using the meeting room at three?

d4-meeting-room-3.text: No reason. It's just that the client moved our call to three, and it's the only room with a screen.

d4-misheard-name-1.text: So what should I bring to Thanksgiving? Wine? Flowers?

d4-misheard-name-2.text: Honestly, just bring yourself. My mom's been cooking since Tuesday.

d4-misheard-name-3.text: Come on, I can't show up empty-handed.

d4-neighbour-party-1.text: Hey! Sorry to bother you. Sounded like a fun party on Saturday.

d4-neighbour-party-2.text: Oh, thanks! Hope it wasn't too loud.

d4-neighbour-party-3.text: Well... the baby was up till two, to be honest.

d4-oat-latte-2.text: Uh, I think that's mine, but I asked for it hot.

d4-oat-latte-3.text: Oh, shoot. Sorry about that. Lemme remake it for ya, it'll just be a minute.

d4-parcel-1.text: Package for twelve B? No one's answering.

d4-parcel-2.text: Oh, they're away till Friday. I can take it if you want.

d4-parcel-3.text: Thanks. Just sign here, an' I'll leave a note on their door.

d4-pizza-diet-1.text: There's a new pizza place opening Friday. Wanna go?

d4-pizza-diet-2.text: Ooh, Friday... I'd love to, but I'm kinda tryin' to be good this month.

d4-pizza-diet-4.text: Hmm. Let me check my calendar and get back to you.

d4-receptionist-1.text: Hi, I was hoping to get my dog groomed sometime this week.

d4-receptionist-2.text: We're booked solid till the twentieth, but I could put you on our waitlist.

d4-receptionist-3.text: Okay, sure. And if nothing opens up?

d4-receptionist-4.text: Then it's the twentieth at ten after nine. Fair warning, he'll come home in a bandana.

d4-service-charge-1.text: Hang on, the tablet's asking for a fifteen percent tip. For one muffin?

d4-service-charge-2.text: Yeah, everywhere does that now. Even the self-checkout!

d4-service-charge-3.text: So is it rude if I just hit 'No tip'?

d4-squat-form-1.text: Okay, ten more squats. Keep your chest up!

d4-squat-form-3.text: Almost. You're kinda leaning forward. Try sittin' back, like there's a chair behind ya.

d4-store-credit-1.text: Hi, I'd like to return these headphones. They stopped working after a week.

d4-store-credit-3.text: Uh, no, it was a gift.

d4-store-credit-4.text: Then I'm afraid all I can offer is store credit.

d4-taxi-street-1.text: Could you take me to Lincoln Street, please?

d4-taxi-street-3.text: Sorry, Street. Lincoln Street, by the park.

d4-taxi-street-4.text: Oh, gotcha. Totally different direction. Good thing ya said something.

d4-train-cancelled-1.text: Excuse me, is the eight forty to Philadelphia still running?

d4-train-cancelled-2.text: It's been canceled, I'm afraid. There's a signal problem outside Trenton.

d4-train-cancelled-3.text: Great. So how do I get there?

d4-train-cancelled-4.text: Your best bet's the shuttle bus. It leaves from out front, by the taxi stand.

d4-video-call-1.text: Morning, everyone. Can you all hear me?

d4-video-call-2.text: We can, but you're breaking up a bit. Maybe turn your video off?

d4-video-call-4.text: Much. Oh, and Sam, you're on mute.

d4-wrong-dish-2.text: Sorry, I think there's been a mix-up. I ordered the club sandwich.

d4-wrong-dish-3.text: Oh, my bad! We're out of turkey, though. Would the BLT work?

dho-allow-it-1.text: Great talk, but isn't this just common sense with nicer slides?

dho-allow-it-2.text: Ha. Partly, sure. But common sense also told us the Earth was flat.

dho-benches-1.text: The study found that adding benches increased foot traffic to local stores by nearly a fifth.

dho-benches-2.text: Benches? Not bike lanes, not parking? Benches?

dho-benches-3.text: People who can sit down stay longer. People who stay longer spend more.

dho-breaking-up-1.text: Next caller, you're on the air. Go ahead.

dho-breaking-up-2.text: Yeah, hi, long-time listener, first-time... sorry, is this... can you hear me?

dho-breaking-up-3.text: Just barely. You're breaking up a little. Where are you calling from?

dho-chocolate-1.text: So, does this new study prove that chocolate is good for you?

dho-chocolate-2.text: 'Prove' is a strong word. It found a link in about two hundred people, and it was funded by a chocolate company.

dho-chocolate-3.text: Ah. Funded by them. I see.

dho-cool-change-1.text: We're looking at a hundred and five in Phoenix today, so if you're thinking of a jog at lunch...

dho-cool-change-2.text: Don't. Just don't. Seriously, stay inside with the AC.

dho-cool-change-3.text: Cooler air is supposed to move in around seven tonight, though.

dho-episode-three-1.text: Have you watched it yet? Everyone says episode three's where it gets good.

dho-episode-three-2.text: I gave up after two. If I need three hours to get to the good part...

dho-episode-three-3.text: Okay, but episode three is genuinely one of the best hours of TV I've seen this year.

dho-episode-three-4.text: Fine. One more. But if it's not, you're buying lunch.

dho-fewer-dates-1.text: Final question. If you could change one thing about how we teach history, what would it be?

dho-fewer-dates-2.text: Fewer dates, more 'why'. Nobody remembers eighteen oh three, but everyone remembers a good argument.

dho-fewer-dates-3.text: I bet a few historians listening just spit out their coffee.

dho-fossil-bias-1.text: Sorry, just to check: are you saying the fossil record is incomplete, or that it's misleading?

dho-fossil-bias-2.text: Both, rather. Incomplete, because most creatures never fossilise. Misleading, because the ones that do are mostly the hard-shelled ones.

dho-fossil-bias-3.text: So we're seeing a biased sample.

dho-great-wall-1.text: Quick correction from last week: I said the Great Wall's visible from space. It isn't.

dho-great-wall-3.text: Not with the naked eye. Several of you emailed. Some of you were very polite about it.

dho-happy-accident-1.text: Your new album is entirely acoustic. Was that a deliberate choice?

dho-happy-accident-2.text: Deliberate is generous. The studio flooded, and the only thing that survived was my old guitar.

dho-happy-accident-4.text: A happy accident. Don't tell the critics.

dho-headline-1.text: Four years ago you said you'd retire after this one. Still the plan?

dho-headline-2.text: Ask me in a month. Right now my body says yes, but my head's not so sure.

dho-headline-4.text: That's a 'don't put it in the headline'.

dho-heat-island-1.text: Why does it always feel hotter in the city than out at my parents' place?

dho-heat-island-2.text: The heat island effect. Concrete and roads soak up heat all day and let it out at night.

dho-heat-island-3.text: So it's worse at night, not during the day?

dho-heat-island-4.text: The gap's biggest at night. That's when the city can be fifteen degrees warmer.

dho-hours-quality-1.text: The productivity figures speak for themselves. People at home work longer hours.

dho-hours-quality-2.text: Longer, yes. Better? That's a different question, and your figures don't answer it.

dho-hours-quality-3.text: With respect, you can't just wave away the data.

dho-hours-quality-4.text: I'm not waving it away. I'm asking what it actually measures.

dho-lab-notes-1.text: So the famous story is that he discovered it completely by accident.

dho-lab-notes-2.text: That's the story he told. His lab notes tell a very different one.

dho-lab-notes-4.text: He'd been chasing it for two years. The 'accident' made a better headline.

dho-let-me-finish-1.text: The problem with congestion pricing is it hits the people who can least afford—

dho-let-me-finish-2.text: Sorry, but the evidence from three cities says the opposite.

dho-let-me-finish-3.text: If you'd let me finish, I was gonna say: unless the money goes back into buses.

dho-look-away-1.text: And with that, let's go to sports. Any good news?

dho-look-away-2.text: Depends who you root for. If it's the home team, I'd look away now.

dho-nine-years-1.text: Okay, so I looked it up, an' the average person spends, like, nine years of their life on their phone.

dho-nine-years-2.text: Nine? That can't be right. Where's that from?

dho-nine-years-3.text: A, um, a blog. Which cited another blog.

dho-print-money-1.text: So why can't the government just print more money and pay off everyone's debts?

dho-print-money-2.text: It can. Once. Then prices go up, and the money everyone's holding is worth less.

dho-print-money-3.text: So the debts shrink, but so do people's savings.

dho-reported-crime-1.text: Crime is down eleven percent from last year.

dho-reported-crime-2.text: Reported crime. Which isn't quite the same thing.

dho-spread-them-1.text: Overtourism isn't really about numbers. Kyoto in November and Kyoto in February are two different cities.

dho-spread-them-2.text: So spread visitors across the year, rather than cap them?

dho-spread-them-3.text: Across the year and across the country. Most visitors see the same six places.

dho-starter-1.text: You've said Japanese food changed how you cook. In what way?

dho-starter-2.text: Restraint, mostly. I used to put twelve things on a plate. Now it's three, and each one has to earn its place.

dho-starter-3.text: Do your customers ever ask where the rest is?

dho-swim-1.text: The bridge is closed northbound, so use the tunnel.

dho-swim-2.text: Actually, we're just hearing the tunnel's closed too, for a stalled bus.

dho-swim-3.text: Oh, terrific. So what are our listeners supposed to do, swim?

dho-touch-cheerful-1.text: Can we go again on that line? You sounded a touch too cheerful for a glacier that's disappearing.

dho-touch-cheerful-2.text: Fair point. A little less 'vacation commercial', a little more 'funeral'?

dho-yes-or-no-1.text: Customers waited up to six hours on hold. Will there be compensation?

dho-yes-or-no-2.text: What I can say is that we've doubled the size of our support team since March.

dho-yes-or-no-3.text: That's not what I asked. Will there be compensation, yes or no?

dho-your-job-1.text: Where do you see yourself in five years?

dho-your-job-3.text: Bold. I'll let my boss know you're coming for me.

dk-allergy-1.text: Quick question. Does the pad thai have peanuts in it?

dk-allergy-2.text: It does, but I can ask the kitchen to leave them off.

dk-allergy-4.text: Leave them off. No peanuts. Or I can put them on the side for your friend.

dk-allergy-5.text: Oh, perfect. No peanuts, then. Thanks!

dk-anyway-hint-1.text: So that was my weekend. The game was crazy. You'd have loved it!

dk-anyway-hint-2.text: Sounds amazing. Anyway, it's getting pretty late here.

dk-bad-time-1.text: Hi Bob! Sorry, is now a bad time?

dk-bad-time-2.text: Ah, kinda. I'm just heading into the gym. Can I call you back tonight?

dk-bad-time-3.text: Of course! It's nothing urgent. Talk later!

dk-bakery-1.text: Oh, the bakery we talked about? It's on the left after the bridge.

dk-bakery-2.text: Wait, do you mean the big bridge or the little one?

dk-bakery-3.text: The big one. And sorry, I meant before the bridge, not after. If you see the river, you've gone too far.

dk-bbq-chair-1.text: So, the barbecue's by the river at noon. Can you bring the drinks?

dk-bbq-chair-2.text: Sure. Lemme check what's in my fridge first.

dk-bbq-chair-3.text: Oh, and bring a chair. There aren't any benches.

dk-bbq-parents-1.text: Hey, we're doing a barbecue by the river Sunday. You in?

dk-bbq-parents-2.text: Aw, that sounds fun, but I'm gonna pass. My parents are visiting.

dk-bday-call-1.text: Hey Molly, quick question. Is Kicks's party still on Friday?

dk-bday-call-2.text: It moved to Saturday. Same time, but at the karaoke place in Shibuya now.

dk-bday-call-3.text: Saturday at the karaoke place. Got it. Should I bring anything?

dk-bday-call-4.text: Just your singing voice! Okay, I'll let you go. See you Saturday!

dk-booking-1.text: Sunny Clinic, this is Pashmina. How can I help you?

dk-booking-2.text: Hi, I'd like to make an appointment. I've had a sore throat for a few days.

dk-booking-3.text: Okay. The soonest we have is Thursday at ten-fifteen. Does that work?

dk-booking-4.text: Sorry, did you say ten-fifteen or ten-fifty?

dk-booking-5.text: Ten-fifteen. A quarter after ten. And please come in a few minutes early.

dk-booking-6.text: Got it. Thursday at ten-fifteen. Thanks!

dk-boss-call-1.text: Hi Gulliver, sorry, quick question. Did you send the slides to the client?

dk-boss-call-2.text: Yep, this morning. They loved them.

dk-boss-call-3.text: Perfect. Okay, I won't keep you. Let's pick it up on Monday.

dk-boss-call-4.text: Sounds good. Have a good weekend!

dk-brunch-1.text: Morning! So, the pancakes come with eggs or fruit.

dk-brunch-2.text: Fruit, please. And could I get the syrup on the side?

dk-brunch-3.text: Sure thing. And it's two dollars extra for bacon, if you want it.

dk-brunch-4.text: Hmm, no, I'm good. Just the pancakes.

dk-call-back-1.text: Hi, it's me. I got your voicemail about dinner, but it was all crackly. Do you mean Thursday or Tuesday?

dk-call-back-2.text: Tuesday! Tues, day. The day after Monday.

dk-call-back-3.text: Ha, got it. Okay, I won't keep you. Talk soon!

dk-catch-up-1.text: Ha! Oh, I've missed you. Anyway, I should let you get back to your packing.

dk-catch-up-2.text: Yeah, I still have the whole kitchen to do. So that's Sunday at the station, then?

dk-catch-up-3.text: Sunday, ten o'clock, by the ticket gates. I'll text you when I'm on the train.

dk-catch-up-4.text: Perfect. Good to catch up, Goldie. Talk soon!

dk-clarify-end-1.text: Okay, I'd better go. So that's Saturday, right?

dk-clarify-end-2.text: Sorry, did you say Saturday? I thought we said Sunday.

dk-clarify-end-3.text: Oh, I meant Sunday! Sunday lunch. Sorry, my head's all over the place.

dk-clarify-end-4.text: Ha, no problem. Sunday it is. See you then!

dk-common-hiking-1.text: Bob, this is Maple. She just moved here from Seattle.

dk-common-hiking-2.text: Oh, nice ta meetcha! What brings ya to Tokyo?

dk-common-hiking-3.text: Work, mostly. But I'm really here for the mountains. I love hiking.

dk-common-hiking-4.text: See? I told you two you'd have a lot in common. Bob hikes every weekend.

dk-cookies-1.text: Thanks again for watching the cat. Here, I brought you some cookies.

dk-cookies-2.text: Aw, you didn't have to do that!

dk-cookies-3.text: It's no big deal. Seriously, it was a huge help. Anyway, I'll let you go.

dk-cousin-bakery-1.text: Hi! I don't think we've met. I'm Goldie, Marshal's cousin.

dk-cousin-bakery-2.text: Oh, hey! I'm Sherb. I work with Marshal at the bakery.

dk-cousin-bakery-3.text: No way! So you're the one who makes those amazing croissants?

dk-cut-out-1.text: Hey! Quick change: let's meet at the west exit, not the south one, at quarter to six.

dk-cut-out-2.text: Sorry, you cut out. What was the last part?

dk-cut-out-3.text: Quarter to six! Five forty-five. At the west exit.

dk-dentist-day-1.text: Hi, this is Olivia from Bright Smile Dental, calling ta confirm yer cleaning on Tuesday at eleven-forty.

dk-dentist-day-2.text: Oh, sorry, did you say Tuesday? I thought it was Wednesday.

dk-dentist-day-3.text: Let me check. Oh, you're right, I'm sorry. Wednesday at eleven-forty.

dk-diner-order-1.text: Hi there! Are you guys ready to order, or do you need a minute?

dk-diner-order-2.text: I think we're ready. Can I get the chicken sandwich?

dk-diner-order-3.text: Sure. That comes with fries or a side salad.

dk-diner-order-4.text: Salad, please, with the dressing on the side.

dk-diner-order-5.text: You got it. Anything to drink?

dk-diner-order-7.text: Perfect. I'll be right back with your water.

dk-dinner-move-1.text: Hey, it's me! Are we still on for dinner tonight?

dk-dinner-move-2.text: About that… something's come up at work. Could we push it back to Thursday?

dk-dinner-move-3.text: Sorry, say that again? A truck's going past.

dk-dinner-move-4.text: Thursday! Same place, seven o'clock. Does that work for you?

dk-dinner-move-5.text: Thursday at seven. Perfect, see you then!

dk-dinner-place-1.text: Oh, and actually, can we do the ramen place instead? The pizza place is closed on Thursdays.

dk-dinner-place-3.text: No, the other one, near the park. I'll text you the map.

dk-dog-bark-1.text: Hey! How's it going? Nice weather, huh?

dk-dog-bark-3.text: So, this is no big deal, but yer dog was barkin' kinda a lot las' night. Jus' so ya know.

dk-dog-bark-4.text: Oh no, I'm so sorry! I mean, I had no idea. I'll keep an eye on him.

dk-dress-honest-1.text: Okay, be honest. Does this dress look weird?

dk-dress-honest-2.text: It's not weird! It's just a little big on you.

dk-dress-honest-3.text: Ugh, I knew it. They're out of the small, though.

dk-dress-honest-4.text: Let's ask. Maybe they have one in the back.

dk-fast-agree-1.text: So that's the cookout at my place, Saturday, from two. Bring a chair if you have one.

dk-fast-agree-2.text: Sorry, did you say a chair? Ha, okay, I've got a camping one. Anything else?

dk-fast-agree-3.text: Nah, that's it. Okay, I'll letcha go. See you Saturday!

dk-fast-birthday-1.text: Next! Hi, checking in? Name and date of birth?

dk-fast-both-1.text: Okay, so Friday's karaoke, Saturday's the beach. You in for both?

dk-fast-both-2.text: Friday, yes, count me in. Saturday, I mean, I'll try ta make it, but I've got my cousin's thing.

dk-fast-both-3.text: So that's a yes for Friday and a maybe for Saturday?

dk-fast-both-4.text: Ha, more like a no for Saturday. Sorry!

dk-fast-check-1.text: Here's your check! No rush. Take your time.

dk-fast-check-2.text: Thanks. Sorry, did you say the tip's included?

dk-fast-check-3.text: Nope, the tip isn't included. Cash or card is fine.

dk-fast-clock-1.text: Hey, where are you? It's so loud here.

dk-fast-clock-2.text: Sorry, the line's crazy. Lemme see... okay, I'm by the big clock.

dk-fast-clock-3.text: Didja say the big clock? Okay, I'll meetcha there in five.

dk-fast-find-host-1.text: Anyway, I should go find the host and say hi.

dk-fast-find-host-2.text: Sure! It was so great ta meetcha. Let's grab coffee sometime.

dk-fast-fireworks-1.text: Okay, so the fireworks start at seven-thirty, but the trains are gonna be packed.

dk-fast-fireworks-2.text: Then let's head over at like five and grab a spot by the river.

dk-fast-fireworks-3.text: Five's early. I mean, I'm down, but I work till four.

dk-fast-fireworks-4.text: So that's five-thirty, at the station? I'll bring a mat.

dk-fast-fireworks-5.text: Perfect. Text me when you're there.

dk-fast-headcount-1.text: So, are you coming Saturday or not? I need a headcount.

dk-fast-headcount-2.text: Ugh, I'm gonna pass this time. Sorry! Anyway, I've gotta run.

dk-fast-intros-1.text: Okay, quick intros! Diana, this is Pietro, my old roommate. And Cherry's my neighbor.

dk-fast-intros-2.text: Hi! Sorry, didja say neighbor or coworker?

dk-fast-intros-3.text: Neighbor! She lives right upstairs. And you all love karaoke, so...

dk-fast-intros-4.text: Ha! Okay, I'm in. Nice ta meetcha both!

dk-fast-ladder-2.text: Yep, I'll stop by with the ladder. Anyway, I won't keep you.

dk-fast-late-doc-1.text: Hi, this is Sunny Clinic callin' for Bea. Dr. Julian's runnin' late today, so we need ta push yer three-forty to four-fifteen. Is that okay?

dk-fast-late-doc-2.text: Sorry, it's loud here. Did you say four-fifty?

dk-fast-late-doc-3.text: Four-fifteen. A quarter after four. And bring yer insurance card, please.

dk-fast-parking-1.text: Hey! Sorry, quick thing, I know yer busy. So, my sister's flyin' in Friday, an' I hay' ta ask, but wouldja mind if she parked in yer spot? Jus' for the weekend.

dk-fast-parking-2.text: Oh, sure, no big deal. Which car?

dk-fast-parking-3.text: A little red one. I'll text you the plate number. Anyway, I'll let you go!

dk-fast-replan-1.text: Hey! Can you hear me? I'm on the street.

dk-fast-replan-3.text: So, I can't make it at six, my shift's running long. Can we say seven, at the bar instead of the café?

dk-fast-replan-4.text: Sorry, did you say the bar?

dk-fast-replan-6.text: Works for me. See you then!

dk-fast-sweater-1.text: Hey! So the gray sweater ya wanted? We're all oudda the medium, but there's a large, an' it runs a liddle small, so it might actually work.

dk-fast-sweater-2.text: Oh, nice. Can I try it on real quick?

dk-fast-text-1.text: They're oudda the red in my size. Didja say there's another store by the station?

dk-fast-text-2.text: Yeah, on the second floor a' the mall. Want me ta text ya the address?

dk-fast-wrap-1.text: Hey, can't talk long, I'm walking to the station. Are we still on for tomorrow?

dk-fast-wrap-2.text: Yep! Eleven at the café. And bring cash. The farmers market after is cash only.

dk-fast-wrap-3.text: So that's eleven, with cash. Got it. Okay, gotta run. Text me if anything changes!

dk-for-here-1.text: Hi! What can I get for you?

dk-for-here-2.text: Can I get a turkey club and a small coffee?

dk-for-here-3.text: Sure. For here or to go?

dk-forgot-name-1.text: Hey! Good to see you again.

dk-forgot-name-2.text: Yeah! Um, sorry, what was your name again?

dk-forgot-name-3.text: Bob! We met at Marshal's barbecue last summer.

dk-game-night-1.text: We're doin' a game night Thursday. Wanna come?

dk-game-night-2.text: Ugh, I wish. I'm swamped with work this week.

dk-game-night-3.text: No worries. We do it every month, so maybe nex' time!

dk-gig-date-1.text: Guess what? I got us tickets for the Tokyo Dome show! It's on the thirteenth.

dk-gig-date-2.text: Sorry? Did you say the thirtieth?

dk-gig-date-3.text: No, the thirteenth. One, three. It's a Friday, so we can go straight from work.

dk-gig-date-4.text: Ha, Friday the thirteenth. Okay, so that's a date!

dk-gig-seats-1.text: Wait, where are our seats? Like, how far back?

dk-gig-seats-2.text: Row fifteen. Oh, actually, no, I meant row fifty. Fifty. We're basically in the nosebleeds.

dk-gotta-run-1.text: Hey! So did you end up watching that show I told you about?

dk-gotta-run-2.text: I'm three episodes in. It's so good! Listen, I've gotta run, my bus is here.

dk-hike-dinner-4.text: Six? Oof. I'm gonna pass on the hike, but count me in for dinner after.

dk-hike-later-1.text: Hey, about tomorrow's hike. It's supposed ta rain in the morning.

dk-hike-later-2.text: Oh no. So, are we canceling?

dk-hike-later-3.text: Nah, let's jus' play it by ear. If it clears up, we'll start at one instead of nine.

dk-hike-later-4.text: Okay. Text me in the morning, then.

dk-jacket-size-1.text: Hi! Can I help you find anything?

dk-jacket-size-2.text: Do you have this jacket a size up? The medium's a little tight.

dk-jacket-size-3.text: Let me check in the back. Hmm, we're all out of large in black, but I have it in navy.

dk-jacket-size-4.text: Navy's fine. Can I try it on?

dk-jacket-size-5.text: Of course! The fitting rooms are right over there.

dk-just-looking-1.text: Hi! Can I help you find a size?

dk-just-looking-2.text: Oh, I'm just looking for now, thanks.

dk-just-looking-3.text: No problem! Just so you know, everything on this wall is thirty percent off.

dk-karaoke-fri-1.text: Hey, a bunch of us are doin' karaoke Friday night. Wanna come?

dk-karaoke-fri-2.text: Ooh, Friday? I've got a work dinner till nine.

dk-karaoke-fri-3.text: We'll be there till late. Come after!

dk-karaoke-fri-4.text: Okay, then count me in. I'll text ya when I'm on my way.

dk-long-goodbye-1.text: Okay, I really have to go. Text me when you get home, yeah?

dk-long-goodbye-2.text: Will do. Oh, and did I tell you about my new neighbor?

dk-long-goodbye-3.text: Ha, tell me tomorrow! Seriously, I'm gonna miss my train.

dk-loud-order-1.text: Sorry, it's crazy in here tonight! So, two of the specials?

dk-loud-order-2.text: One special, and the salmon salad for her, dressing on the side.

dk-loud-order-4.text: Salmon salad! Dressing on the side.

dk-loud-order-5.text: Got it. And it's three dollars extra to add avocado, if you want.

dk-loud-toast-1.text: Everyone! Can I get your attention for two seconds?

dk-loud-toast-2.text: Sorry? I can't hear a thing in here!

dk-loud-toast-3.text: A toast! For Pekoe's mom, sixty today! Glasses up! Here's to Linda!

dk-meet-coworker-1.text: Hey, Kidd! Have you two met? This is my coworker, Audie.

dk-meet-coworker-2.text: No, I don't think so. Hi, nice ta meetcha!

dk-meet-coworker-3.text: Nice ta meetcha too! So, how d'you know Marshal?

dk-meet-coworker-4.text: Oh, we go way back. We played soccer in high school.

dk-meet-coworker-5.text: And Audie plays soccer every Sunday. You guys have a lot in common.

dk-move-appt-1.text: Hi, I have an appointment tomorrow at nine, but I need to move it.

dk-move-appt-2.text: No problem. The soonest I have after that is Monday at two-thirty.

dk-move-appt-3.text: Monday at two-thirty? That works. Is there a fee for changing?

dk-move-appt-4.text: Not if it's more than a day before. So you're all set. See you then!

dk-movie-switch-1.text: Hey! So, small change of plan for the movie.

dk-movie-switch-2.text: Uh-oh. You're not canceling, are you?

dk-movie-switch-3.text: No, no! I'm just running late. Can we do the eight forty show instead of seven fifteen?

dk-movie-switch-4.text: Sure. So that's eight forty. I'll grab dinner first, then. See you there!

dk-music-down-1.text: Hi, sorry to bug you so late.

dk-music-down-3.text: Wouldja mind turnin' the music down a little? The baby's tryin' ta sleep.

dk-package-1.text: Hi there! Sorry ta bother ya. I'm Tom, from nex' door.

dk-package-2.text: Oh, hi! Nice to meet you.

dk-package-3.text: So, I hay' ta ask, but I've got a package comin' tomorrow, an' I'll be at work. Wouldja mind signin' for it?

dk-package-4.text: Not at all! Just knock when you get home.

dk-package-5.text: Thanks so much. It's no big deal if you're out. They'll just leave a note.

dk-party-gift-1.text: Oh, what about a present? Are we all getting her something?

dk-party-gift-2.text: We're chipping in for one big thing, those wireless headphones she wants. Like two thousand yen each?

dk-party-invite-1.text: Hey Sterling! Are you free on Saturday night?

dk-party-invite-2.text: I think so. Why, what's going on?

dk-party-invite-3.text: It's Tia's birthday, and we're throwing her a surprise party at my place. Don't tell her!

dk-party-invite-4.text: My lips are sealed. Should I bring anything?

dk-party-invite-5.text: Maybe some snacks? And get there before seven. She's showing up at seven-thirty.

dk-party-invite-6.text: So that's Saturday, before seven, at your place. Got it!

dk-penicillin-1.text: Before I fill this, are you allergic to anything?

dk-penicillin-3.text: Okay, good to know. This one's fine, then. It's not penicillin.

dk-pharmacy-pick-1.text: Hi there! Your prescription's ready. Can I get your date of birth?

dk-pharmacy-pick-3.text: Perfect. Take one tablet twice a day, with food. Any questions?

dk-phone-clarify-1.text: Hey! I'm at the café already, upstairs by the window. Where are you?

dk-phone-clarify-2.text: Sorry, say that again? The traffic's crazy out here.

dk-phone-clarify-3.text: Up... stairs. By the window. Anyway, see you in a sec!

dk-pickup-fifteen-2.text: Yes, for Kid Cat. Is my prescription ready?

dk-pickup-fifteen-3.text: It is! That's fifteen dollars with yer insurance. Oh, and take it with food.

dk-picnic-bring-1.text: Hey! We're doing a picnic in the park on Saturday. You in?

dk-picnic-bring-3.text: Maybe some snacks? An' it's supposed ta be chilly, so bring a jacket.

dk-rain-sunday-1.text: So, are we still doing the flea market Saturday?

dk-rain-sunday-2.text: Lemme check the weather. Ugh, it's supposed ta rain all day Saturday.

dk-rain-sunday-4.text: Sunday looks sunny. But the line for the food trucks is gonna be crazy.

dk-rain-sunday-5.text: Then let's get there early, like nine, and beat the crowds.

dk-rain-sunday-6.text: I'm down. See you at the station at nine!

dk-really-cancel-1.text: Hey Tammy, about the beach tomorrow. Have you seen the forecast?

dk-really-cancel-2.text: I know, it's supposed to pour. Should we take a rain check?

dk-really-cancel-3.text: Yeah. How about next Saturday instead? Same time?

dk-really-cancel-4.text: Next Saturday works. I'll put it in my calendar. Talk soon!

dk-recycling-1.text: Oh, hey! Jus' so ya know, recycling is Thursdays now, not Mondays.

dk-recycling-3.text: Since las' week. I only found out 'cause they left mine on the curb!
