dk-recycling-4.text: Ha! Good to know. Thanks for the heads-up. Talk soon!

dk-rice-swap-1.text: Can I get the fish tacos, but with rice instead of the beans?

dk-rice-swap-2.text: Sure, but just so you know, swapping is a dollar extra.

dk-runs-small-1.text: Those jeans run small, so I'd go a size up.

dk-runs-small-2.text: Oh, really? I'm usually a thirty-two.

dk-shh-1.text: Morning! So, any plans for Tia's birthday?

dk-shoe-pair-1.text: Sorry, we're all out of the white ones in a nine.

dk-shoe-pair-2.text: Oh, no. Do you have them in a nine and a half?

dk-shoe-pair-3.text: Let me check in the back. Okay, good news. I've got one pair left.

dk-shoe-pair-4.text: Did you say one pair? Great! Can I try them on?

dk-sister-heard-1.text: Phoebe! Come meet Judy. Judy, this is my sister, Phoebe.

dk-sister-heard-2.text: Oh my gosh, hi! I've heard so much aboutcha!

dk-sold-aquarium-1.text: Bad news. The dinosaur exhibit is sold out this weekend.

dk-sold-aquarium-2.text: Seriously? Okay, what about the aquarium?

dk-sold-aquarium-3.text: I mean, it's supposed ta rain anyway, so the aquarium's perfect.

dk-sold-aquarium-4.text: And it's indoors. Let's do it. Saturday at one?

dk-sold-aquarium-5.text: Perfect. I'll text you when I'm on my way.

dk-spare-key-1.text: Hey, I'm gonna stop by later with yer spare key, if that's okay.

dk-spare-key-3.text: Around six? Anyway, I'll let you get back to it.

dk-surprise-hide-1.text: She's here! I can hear her on the stairs!

dk-surprise-hide-2.text: Quiet, everyone! Who's got the lights?

dk-surprise-hide-3.text: Got it. Everyone hide behind the couch, and wait for my signal.

dk-thats-a-no-1.text: Are you coming to the movie tonight?

dk-thats-a-no-2.text: Maybe? I'll try ta make it, but I'm super tired.

dk-thats-a-no-3.text: Okay. So that's a no, huh?

dk-toast-1.text: Okay, everyone, grab a glass! Quick toast.

dk-toast-3.text: Here's to Tia: the best neighbor, the worst singer, and now officially thirty! Cheers!

dk-try-make-it-1.text: So, my birthday drinks are Saturday. You're coming, right?

dk-try-make-it-2.text: Uh, yeah, I'll try ta make it. I'm kinda swamped this weekend.

dk-way-back-kinder-1.text: So, how d'you two know each other?

dk-way-back-kinder-2.text: Oh, me and Marshal? I mean, we go way back. Like, kindergarten.

dk-which-blue-1.text: Which one should I get? This or that?

dk-which-blue-2.text: The blue one. It looks great on you.

dk-which-blue-3.text: Do you mean the light blue or the dark one?

dk-which-blue-4.text: The dark one. The light one's a little big.

dk-wrong-order-1.text: Excuse me, I think this is the wrong burger. I asked for no cheese.

dk-wrong-order-2.text: Oh, I'm so sorry about that! Let me get that fixed for you. I'll be right back.

dk-wrong-time-1.text: So we're meeting at Shibuya at six thirty, right?

dk-wrong-time-2.text: Sorry? It's so loud in here. Did you say Shibuya?

dk-wrong-time-3.text: Wait, no, Ebisu. East exit. And it's seven thirty, not six thirty. Sorry, long day.

dk-wrong-time-4.text: Ebisu, seven thirty, east exit. Got it. Text me when you're there.

dk-zoo-pandas-1.text: Okay, so the zoo opens at nine-thirty. Lemme check the map. The pandas are right by the entrance.

dk-zoo-pandas-2.text: Then let's go there first, before the line gets crazy.

dk-zoo-pandas-3.text: Good call. Meet at the gate at nine-fifteen?

dml-card-declined-1.text: Hi, my card got declined at a hotel in Lisbon, and I've got plenty in the account.

dml-card-declined-2.text: Looks like our fraud system flagged it. Didja let us know you'd be traveling?

dml-card-declined-3.text: No, I didn't know I had to.

dml-gutter-1.text: Morning! Your tree's looking very... healthy. It's sorta taken over our gutter.

dml-gutter-2.text: Oh, sorry about that. I've been meaning to get someone out here.

dml-gutter-3.text: No rush. Just before the storms, ideally.

dml-id-only-1.text: Package for apartment six? It needs a signature, and it's for a Ms. Tanaka.

dml-id-only-2.text: She's at work, but I'm her roommate. Can I sign for it?

dml-id-only-3.text: Not this one, it needs her ID. I'll leave a notice, and she can pick it up at our customer center.

dml-id-only-4.text: Fine, I'll tell her. What time does the customer center close?

dml-jet-lag-1.text: Hi, do you have anything for jet lag? I can't sleep at all.

dml-jet-lag-2.text: There's melatonin, but it's not something I'd take with alcohol.

dml-jet-lag-3.text: Ah. I did have a couple of beers at dinner.

dml-jet-lag-4.text: Then I'd hold off till tomorrow night. Get some daylight in the morning instead.

dml-missed-connection-1.text: Okay, so your bag was checked through to Denver, but it missed the connection in Chicago.

dml-missed-connection-2.text: Great. So when will it actually get here?

dml-missed-connection-3.text: It should be on the first flight tomorrow. We can have it delivered to your hotel.

dml-moving-out-cert-1.text: For the moving-in notice, I'll need your residence card and the moving-out certificate from your old ward.

dml-moving-out-cert-2.text: The moving-out what? Nobody mentioned that.

dml-moving-out-cert-3.text: You get it from your previous ward office. Some do it by mail, if that helps.

dml-moving-out-cert-4.text: Okay. I'll call them this afternoon and ask.

dml-one-for-the-road-1.text: Want me ta keep your tab open, or are you closin' out?

dml-one-for-the-road-2.text: Closing out, I think. Actually, you know what, one more for the road.

dml-one-for-the-road-3.text: Another one of those? Or d'you wanna try the seasonal IPA?

dml-party-next-door-1.text: Hi, room five twelve. There's some kinda party going on next door.

dml-party-next-door-2.text: I'm so sorry. Security's on their way up. If it's still goin' in half an hour, call me back.

dml-party-next-door-3.text: And if it is? I've got a seven a.m. flight.

dml-party-next-door-4.text: Then we'll move you to a quiet floor, no charge.

dml-plumber-late-1.text: Hey, it's Joe, the plumber. I'm runnin' a little behind. Traffic's a nightmare.

dml-plumber-late-2.text: How far behind are we talking? I have to leave at noon.

dml-plumber-late-3.text: Forty-five minutes, tops. If you leave a key under the mat, I can let myself in.

dml-power-cut-1.text: Hey, is your power out too? The whole street's gone dark.

dml-power-cut-2.text: Yeah. The app says crews are on it, back by ten, s'posedly.

dml-power-cut-3.text: My freezer's full. Should I be worried?

dml-stylist-1.text: Hi! So Mia's fully booked Saturday, but Jordan has a two o'clock?

dml-stylist-2.text: Hmm, I'd really rather stick with Mia. She knows my hair.

dml-stylist-3.text: Totally. She's got Tuesday at six, or I can text you if Saturday frees up?

dml-stylist-4.text: Let's do both. Book the Tuesday, and text me anyway.

dml-test-results-1.text: Your blood test results are back. The doctor wants to go over them with you.

dml-test-results-3.text: I can't go into it over the phone, but it's not urgent. Next Tuesday's fine.

dml-test-results-4.text: Okay. I'll stop googling my symptoms, then.

dml-via-munich-1.text: I'm afraid the six forty to Rome's been canceled. I can get you on tomorrow's seven fifteen, or a flight tonight via Munich.

dml-via-munich-2.text: And the Munich one gets in when, roughly?

dml-via-munich-3.text: Just after one in the morning, I'm afraid.

dml-work-in-1.text: Hey, man, you got many sets left on that?

dml-work-in-2.text: Two more. You're welcome to work in with me, though.

dml-work-in-3.text: Sweet. You mind if I change the weight between sets?

dml-worn-boots-1.text: Hi, I'd like to return these boots. They pinch at the toes.

dml-worn-boots-2.text: Hmm, the soles are a little scuffed, so they've been worn outside.

dml-worn-boots-3.text: Only once, to the subway and back!

dml-worn-boots-4.text: I can't refund worn items, but I can send 'em back to the manufacturer as defective.

dmu-aircon-1.text: Hi, I'm in eight-oh-four. The air conditioning's making this weird rattling noise.

dmu-aircon-2.text: Oh, I'm so sorry about that. I'll send someone up to take a look.

dmu-aircon-3.text: Thanks. Will it be long? We're about to go to bed.

dmu-aircon-4.text: It could be half an hour, honestly. In the meantime, would you like me to bring up a fan?

dmu-bins-1.text: OK, random question. Where are all the trash cans? I've been carrying this cup for an hour.

dmu-bins-2.text: Ha, yeah. There aren't many. Most people just take their trash home.

dmu-bins-3.text: Seriously? I'm kinda worried I'll get yelled at if I leave it somewhere.

dmu-bins-4.text: You won't. But there's a convenience store on the way. They have trash cans.

dmu-bins-5.text: Oh, thank god. Lead the way.

dmu-coffee-machine-2.text: Yeah, it was nice, thanks. Um, we went hiking, and my legs are, like, still dead. How about you?

dmu-coffee-machine-3.text: Oh, a quiet one. Mostly yard work. Hey, we should grab lunch one of these days.

dmu-coffee-machine-4.text: Totally. Are you free Thursday? There's that new curry place downstairs.

dmu-coffee-machine-6.text: Quarter after? Oh, twelve-fifteen. Perfect. See you then.

dmu-flea-market-1.text: So, uh, any big plans for the weekend?

dmu-flea-market-2.text: Not really. Might go to that flea market by the river, if it doesn't rain.

dmu-flea-market-3.text: Oh, the Sunday one? My wife loves that place. Hey, if you go, we could, um, grab a coffee there?

dmu-flea-market-5.text: So that's ten-ish by the river. Great. I'll text you if it's pouring.

dmu-jetlag-1.text: Morning! Sorry, I'm a bit of a zombie. The jet lag's killing me.

dmu-jetlag-2.text: No problem. I mean, we can take it easy today. Coffee first?

dmu-jetlag-3.text: Yes, please. The thing is, I really wanna see the temple, but I dunno if I'll last a whole day.

dmu-jetlag-4.text: Then let's do the temple this morning and take a nap after lunch.

dmu-jetlag-5.text: You're the best. That's the plan, then.

dmu-last-train-1.text: This bar's awesome. We don't have to go yet, do we?

dmu-last-train-2.text: Well, the last train's at twelve twenty. After that it's a taxi, and they're not cheap.

dmu-last-train-3.text: Sorry, did you say twelve twenty? How not cheap are we talking?

dmu-last-train-4.text: Probably five thousand yen to your hotel.

dmu-last-train-5.text: OK. I'm up for one more, then we run for the train.

dmu-lift-1.text: Oh, hey! Long time no see. How've you been?

dmu-lift-2.text: Good! Crazy busy, but good. Hey, I heard you moved teams?

dmu-lift-3.text: Yeah, I'm in sales now. Ah, this is my floor. We should grab lunch and really catch up.

dmu-luggage-1.text: Hi, we've checked out, but our flight's not till nine tonight. Could we leave our bags?

dmu-luggage-2.text: Of course. I'm afraid the luggage room's full, so they'll go behind the desk. There's a small charge after six.

dmu-luggage-3.text: Hold on, so that's after six? Our train to the airport's at six-thirty.

dmu-luggage-4.text: Ah, then just pick them up by six and there's nothing to pay.

dmu-marinas-lunch-1.text: Oh, hey! Love the haircut. Big weekend?

dmu-marinas-lunch-2.text: Kinda. My sister's kids stayed over, so, uh... not much sleep.

dmu-marinas-lunch-3.text: Ha, I bet. Hey, I've been meaning to ask. Are you free Friday? A few of us are grabbing lunch for Marina's last day.

dmu-monday-1.text: Morning. Wow, you look like you need that coffee.

dmu-monday-2.text: Don't ask. I spent all of Saturday on that report.

dmu-monday-3.text: Oh no. Do you mean the one for Tuesday? I thought that got pushed back.

dmu-monday-4.text: Yeah, I found that out on Sunday night. Awesome.

dmu-monday-5.text: Ouch. Well, coffee's on me, then.

dmu-no-hot-water-1.text: Hi, sorry to bother you. There's no hot water in eleven twelve.

dmu-no-hot-water-2.text: Ah, I'm so sorry. They're working on the water heater this morning. It should be back by ten.

dmu-no-hot-water-3.text: Sorry? Ten? I've got a meeting at nine.

dmu-no-hot-water-4.text: In the meantime, what I can do is open the spa for you. The showers there are fine, and it's complimentary.

dmu-no-hot-water-5.text: Perfect. I'll head down now. Thanks.

dmu-real-plan-1.text: Hey, nice to finally meet you for real. You're on the design team, right?

dmu-real-plan-2.text: That's me. Third floor, by the window. How are you liking it so far?

dmu-real-plan-3.text: Good, good. A little overwhelming. Everyone keeps saying we should grab a coffee.

dmu-real-plan-4.text: Ha, they mean it. I mean, some of them do. I'm free at three tomorrow, if you're up for it?

dmu-ticket-machine-1.text: OK, so this ramen place. Do I pay the chef, or what?

dmu-ticket-machine-2.text: Nope. You buy a ticket from the machine by the door, then hand it over.

dmu-ticket-machine-3.text: So that's a ticket first, then food? The thing is, it's all in Japanese, and I dunno which button's which.

dmu-twin-beds-1.text: Hi, checking in. Lopez, two nights.

dmu-twin-beds-2.text: Welcome. Ah, I'm afraid you've been booked into two queens, not a king, and we're fully booked tonight.

dmu-twin-beds-3.text: Sorry, did you say two queens? Oh. That's not ideal. It's kinda our anniversary.

dmu-twin-beds-4.text: What I can do is move you to a king tomorrow, and breakfast is complimentary both mornings.

dmu-twin-beds-5.text: OK, that works. Thanks for taking care of it.

dmu-which-exit-1.text: Dude, this station is insane. Which exit are we supposed to take?

dmu-which-exit-2.text: South exit. Then it's a ten-minute walk to the shrine. So, what else d'you wanna do while you're here?

dmu-which-exit-3.text: I've heard the fish market's worth it. The thing is, I dunno if I can get up that early.

dmu-which-exit-4.text: Most of it's open till lunch. We could go mid-morning.

dmu-wrong-dates-1.text: Good evening. I have your booking here, but it's for next Friday, not tonight.

dmu-wrong-dates-2.text: Hold on, next Friday? I definitely booked tonight. I mean, I've got the email right here.

dmu-wrong-dates-3.text: Let me have a look. Ah, the booking site messed up the dates. We're full, but what I can do is a room at our sister hotel, and we'll cover the taxi.

dmu-wrong-dates-4.text: Fine. As long as I'm not paying for both.

dmu-wrong-dates-5.text: No, no. I'll cancel this one now, and we'll waive the fee.

dmu-wrong-train-1.text: Hey, it's me. I think I'm on the wrong train. It says Ikebukuro?

dmu-wrong-train-2.text: Oh no. Which way are you going? Did you get on at platform two?

dmu-wrong-train-3.text: I dunno. I just got on the first one that came. Sorry, it's really loud. Could you say that again?

dmu-wrong-train-4.text: I said, get off at the next stop and cross to the other side.

dmu-wrong-train-5.text: Got it. Next stop, other side. I'll call you when I'm on.

dmw-advice-1.text: He texted me again last night. Should I reply?

dmw-advice-2.text: Honestly? If you have to ask, you probably already know the answer.

dmw-advice-3.text: Yeah... I know. I just miss having someone to talk to.

dmw-birthday-1.text: You totally forgot my birthday, didn't you?

dmw-birthday-2.text: I... okay, yes. I have no excuse. I am so sorry.

dmw-birthday-3.text: Relax, I'm messin' with ya. You sent flowers. They're right there.

dmw-cv-gap-1.text: I notice there's a gap on your résumé in twenty twenty-three. Could you tell me about that?

dmw-cv-gap-2.text: Of course. I took a year off to care for my father, and kept my skills up with a few online courses.

dmw-cv-gap-3.text: Thank you for sharing that. Which course did you find most useful?

dmw-deadline-1.text: Do you have a minute? It's about the Friday deadline.

dmw-deadline-2.text: Go ahead. I had a feeling this was coming.

dmw-deadline-3.text: The data from finance only landed this morning. Realistically, I'd need till Tuesday.

dmw-ending-1.text: So what did you think? Be honest.

dmw-ending-2.text: The first hour was gorgeous. The ending, though... I'm still not sure what happened.

dmw-ending-3.text: That's kinda the point. You're s'posed to make up your own mind.

dmw-frozen-1.text: So if we look at slide four... Sorry, go ahead.

dmw-frozen-2.text: No, you go. I was just gonna say you froze for a sec.

dmw-frozen-3.text: Did I? Can you see me now?

dmw-frozen-4.text: Yep, you're back. But we lost you around slide two, so maybe start from there.

dmw-gossip-1.text: Did you hear? He's moving to the Singapore office.

dmw-gossip-2.text: No way. Wasn't he up for the manager job here?

dmw-gossip-3.text: That's the thing. Word is, they gave it to someone else, and he saw the writing on the wall.

dmw-gossip-4.text: Huh. Can't say I blame him.

dmw-haircut-1.text: Okay, I love the hair. When did you get that done?

dmw-haircut-2.text: Thanks! Yesterday. The barber got a little carried away, to be honest.

dmw-haircut-3.text: Well, it suits you. Shorter's definitely better.

dmw-it-desk-1.text: IT desk, what seems to be the problem?

dmw-it-desk-2.text: My laptop keeps freezing whenever I join a video call. I've restarted it twice.

dmw-it-desk-3.text: Okay. Can you read me the asset number? It's on a sticker underneath.

dmw-plan-b-1.text: So are we still doing the beer garden on Saturday?

dmw-plan-b-2.text: It's supposed to pour all day. What about bowling instead?

dmw-plan-b-3.text: Ugh, fine. But only if we get tacos after.

dmw-plan-b-4.text: Deal. I'll let the others know.

dmw-praise-sandwich-1.text: So, overall, a really solid quarter. The clients love working with you.

dmw-praise-sandwich-2.text: Oh, thanks! That's good to hear.

dmw-praise-sandwich-3.text: The one thing I'd flag is the reports. A couple went out late, and, uh, people noticed. But honestly, keep doing what you're doing.

dmw-pto-1.text: So all your PTO goes through the HR portal, and anything over two days needs your manager's sign-off. Does that make sense?

dmw-scope-1.text: While we're at it, could we add a French version of the site? Shouldn't be a big job.

dmw-scope-2.text: We'd love to help with that. It's outside the current scope, though, so I'll send over a separate quote.

dmw-scope-3.text: Oh. I was kinda hoping it'd be included.

dmw-scope-4.text: I understand. Lemme see if we can do something on the price.

dmw-standup-1.text: Okay, quick round. Yesterday I wrapped up the login page, and today it's the tests.

dmw-standup-2.text: Nice. I'm still stuck on the payments piece, waitin' on the API keys from the client. Can't do much till they come through.

dmw-standup-3.text: Want me to follow up with them? I've got a call with them at two anyway.

dmw-standup-4.text: Would you? That'd be a huge help.

dmw-which-friday-1.text: Dinner next Friday, then? I'll make a reservation somewhere.

dmw-which-friday-2.text: Sounds good. Wait, do you mean this Friday or the one after?

dmw-which-friday-3.text: Not tomorrow, the one after. The fourteenth.

dmw-which-friday-4.text: Oh good, I'm away this weekend anyway.

dr-ankle-sprained-1.text: I twisted it playin' basketball on Saturday.

dr-ankle-sprained-2.text: Okay. Does it hurt when ya put weight on it?

dr-ankle-sprained-3.text: A little. It hurts on an' off.

dr-ankle-sprained-4.text: Well, the X-ray looks fine. It's not broken. It's sprained. Ice it, keep it up, an' take it easy. No basketball for two weeks.

dr-fast-m-stomach.text: Okay, so, one in the mornin', one at night, with food, an' if yer stomach gets upset, call me. Don't just stop takin' it.

dr-fast-m-urgent.text: If it gets worse over the weekend, don't wait fer Monday. Go ta urgent care. They're open till nine.

dr-fast-n-14th.text: So yer follow-up's on the thirteenth at two-thirty. Oh, wait, he's out that day. Let's do the fourteenth, same time, an' come in ten minutes early.

dr-fast-r-same.text: So how long's this been goin' on, an' is it gettin' worse, or is it about the same?

dr-fast-results-1.text: Hi, Bea, it's Pashmina from Dr. Julian's office. Yer blood test came back, an' everything looks normal.

dr-fast-results-2.text: Oh, thank goodness. So, nothing serious?

dr-fast-results-3.text: Nothing serious. He just wants ya ta cut back on coffee an' come back in three months fer another one.

dr-fast-soccer-1.text: So no running for two weeks. Swimming's fine, biking's fine, just nothin' with impact.

dr-fast-soccer-2.text: What about my soccer game Sunday?

dr-hurt-here-1.text: Does it hurt when I press here?

dr-m-back-to-work.text: You can go back ta work tomorrow. Just take it easy. No heavy liftin' for a week.

dr-m-fever.text: If it gets worse, or the fever goes over a hundred and one, don't wait. Come back in right away.

dr-m-headaches.text: The headaches come an' go. They're on an' off, mostly in the afternoon.

dr-m-keep-eye.text: Keep an eye on it, an' come back in a week if it's not better. If it is better, don't bother.

dr-m-sprain.text: It's nothing serious. It's just a sprain, but you'll need ta take it easy for a couple of weeks.

dr-n-follow-up.text: Dr. Julian wants ta see you again in two weeks. The soonest he has is Tuesday the eighteenth at three-forty.

dr-n-hours.text: Take two tablets every six hours, but no more than eight in a day.

dr-n-ten-days.text: Are you allergic ta penicillin? No? Okay. Take these for ten days, even if ya feel better after three.

dr-negative-1.text: So the test came back negative. It's not strep.

dr-negative-2.text: Oh, good. So what is it?

dr-negative-3.text: Probably just a cold. Nothing serious. But if it gets worse, or ya get a fever, call us.

dr-negative-4.text: Got it. Do I need to come back?

dr-negative-5.text: only if it's not better in ten days.

dr-r-dizzy.text: Any other symptoms I should know about?

dr-r-how-long.text: An' how long has this been goin' on?

dr-r-swallow.text: Does it hurt when ya swallow?

dr-r-take-easy.text: So, take it easy fer a few days. No gym, okay?

dr-throat-virus-1.text: So, what brings you in today?

dr-throat-virus-2.text: I've had a sore throat and a cough.

dr-throat-virus-3.text: Okay. How long has this been going on?

dr-throat-virus-4.text: About five days. It's worse at night.

dr-throat-virus-5.text: Lemme take a look. Good news, it's nothing serious. Just a virus. Rest, lotsa fluids, an' come back in a week if it's not better.

dr-tired-next-2.text: No fever. But I've been really tired.

dr-tired-next-3.text: How tired? Like, sleepin' more than usual?

dr-trip-next-1.text: Can I still go on my trip Friday?

dr-trip-next-2.text: Honestly? I'd wait. You're still contagious fer a few more days.

dr-trip-next-4.text: Push it back a week, if ya can.

dr-w-fifty.text: Take fifty milligrams twice a day.

dr-w-gets-worse.text: Call us if it gets worse.

dr-w-not-better.text: Come back if it's not better.

dr-w-on-off.text: It's been on an' off all week.

dvm-ac-out-1.text: The AC's makin' that clickin' noise again, and it's ninety-two degrees out.

dvm-ac-out-2.text: I called the repair place. The earliest they can come is Thursday.

dvm-ac-out-3.text: Thursday? We'll be soup by Thursday.

dvm-bento-1.text: Wait, the cashier asked me something. Was it about my point card?

dvm-bento-2.text: She asked if you want your bento heated up. Just say "onegai shimasu."

dvm-first-date-1.text: So how was the date? I want every detail.

dvm-first-date-2.text: Well, it turned out to be his mom's birthday dinner. So I met his whole family.

dvm-first-date-3.text: On a first date? Oh no.

dvm-first-date-4.text: Honestly? His mom was great. We're getting brunch next week. She and I.

dvm-locked-out-1.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. I think I typed the wrong password, like, five times.

dvm-locked-out-2.text: Happens all the time. I just sent a reset link to your phone. It expires in ten minutes.

dvm-new-phone-1.text: Okay, it wants my old phone's passcode. Which I wrote down... somewhere.

dvm-new-phone-2.text: No problem, Grandpa. We'll skip that and move your photos from the cloud.

dvm-new-phone-3.text: Will I lose my high score in that word game?

dvm-new-phone-4.text: Nope. That's saved to your account. You're all set.

dvm-voice-memo-1.text: Hey, guys, quick update: dinner's moved to Saturday, same place. And you're on dessert, okay?

dvm-voice-memo-2.text: Love it. But I'm bringing store-bought cookies. Nobody wants my baking again.

dvy-almond-milk-1.text: My roommate labeled her almond milk. With her name, the date and a drawing of an eye.

dvy-almond-milk-2.text: An eye? Okay, that's a threat.

dvy-almond-milk-3.text: Right? So obviously I drank some.

dvy-ceiling-1.text: Can you see me? I can see your ceiling. Lovely ceiling.

dvy-ceiling-2.text: Dad, you're holding the phone upside down again.

dvy-ceiling-3.text: Ah. Well, now I can see your face. And your mother's thumb.

dvy-dumpster-1.text: This painting was almost thrown out in nineteen sixty-two. Someone found it behind a dumpster.

dvy-dumpster-2.text: Behind a dumpster? So what is it worth now?

dvy-dumpster-3.text: Let's just say more than this building. Please don't lean on the frame.

dvy-same-car-1.text: Did you see Tyler and Jenna at the barbecue? They showed up in the same car.

dvy-same-car-2.text: They carpool. They live on the same street.

dvy-same-car-3.text: Since when does Jenna live on Elm Street?

dvy-slippers-1.text: Quick question. Everyone left their shoes at Kenji's front door. Do I...?

dvy-slippers-2.text: Yep. Slippers are in the cabinet. Just don't wear them into the bathroom.

dvy-slippers-3.text: Wait, there are separate bathroom slippers?

dvy-toast-1.text: So, I promised the bride I would not tell the Vegas story.

dvy-toast-3.text: Instead, here's the year the groom cooked Thanksgiving. The fire department's here tonight, actually. Hi, guys!

dya-bar-seat-1.text: It's gonna be about a forty-five-minute wait for a table, but the bar's open if you're not picky.

dya-best-man-1.text: So how was the best man's speech?

dya-best-man-2.text: Well. It was long. And he mentioned the ex. Twice.

dya-brave-hair-1.text: Oh wow, your hair! It's so... brave.

dya-brave-hair-2.text: Brave? What's that supposed to mean?

dya-brave-hair-3.text: No, no, I mean it's, like, a statement.

dya-capital-1.text: Last question. What's the capital of Australia?

dya-capital-3.text: You do realise you're saying that in front of an Australian?

dya-celebration-1.text: I thought you were off sugar.

dya-celebration-2.text: I am. This is a celebration cake. Totally different.

dya-celebration-3.text: Right. And what are we celebrating?

dya-chockers-1.text: Mind if I take the back roads? The freeway's a parking lot this time of day.

dya-chockers-2.text: Whatever's fastest. I've got a flight at six.

dya-chockers-3.text: You got it. We'll get you there with time to spare.

dya-could-email-1.text: So that was an hour of my life.

dya-could-email-2.text: Yeah, that coulda been an email. Did we even decide anything?

dya-could-email-3.text: We decided to have another meeting. On Thursday.

dya-dough-1.text: Why do bakers work so hard?

dya-dough-3.text: Because they knead the dough! Get it? Knead? Need?

dya-escalate-1.text: Okay, so have ya tried turnin' it off and back on again?

dya-escalate-2.text: Three times. I also unplugged it, waited, and said a little prayer.

dya-escalate-3.text: Okay, um, lemme escalate this to my supervisor.

dya-flatpack-1.text: Okay, which way does this piece go?

dya-flatpack-2.text: Says here, 'Easy assembly. Two people, thirty minutes.'

dya-flatpack-3.text: We've been at it for three hours.

dya-hang-left-1.text: Sorry, is Grand Central far from here?

dya-hang-left-2.text: Nah, you're good. Hang a left at the light, go, like, three blocks, an' it's gonna be on your right. Can't miss it.

dya-key-code-1.text: The garage code's four-seven-one-nine. No, wait, that's the old one. It's four-seven-nine-one.

dya-key-code-2.text: Got it. And can we park on the street?

dya-key-code-3.text: Sure, just not Tuesday mornings. Street sweeping. They will tow you.

dya-parking-1.text: Want me ta park it? No offense, but we'd like to get home tonight.

dya-parking-2.text: Wow. Okay. I've done this, like, a thousand times.

dya-parking-3.text: Yeah, and that's attempt number four.

dya-pending-1.text: Thanks for holding. I see the charge, but it's still pending, so I can't reverse it just yet.

dya-pending-2.text: So I've been on hold for forty minutes to hear 'try again later'?

dya-pending-3.text: In three to five business days, yes.

dya-promotion-3.text: Nope. Greg. The guy who microwaves fish.

dya-quick-look-1.text: No pressure, but if you could take a quick look at this over the weekend, that'd be awesome.

dya-quick-look-2.text: Sure. Like, a skim, or an actual read?

dya-quick-look-3.text: It's forty pages. But they're short pages.

dya-rent-bump-1.text: So, just a heads-up. With everything goin' up, we're lookin' at a small adjustment to the rent in April.

dya-rent-bump-2.text: Small like a coffee, or small like a car payment?

dya-shift-swap-1.text: Any chance you'd swap your Saturday for my Tuesday? I'll owe you one.

dya-shift-swap-2.text: You already owe me, like, three.

dya-spoiler-1.text: Didja finish the show yet? 'Cause that ending, man.

dya-spoiler-2.text: No! I'm on episode six. Don't you dare.

dya-spoiler-3.text: I'm just saying, keep your eyes on the dog.

dya-third-wheel-1.text: You should totally come to dinner with us on Friday!

dya-third-wheel-2.text: With you and Matt? On your anniversary? I'm good, thanks.

dyb-auto-renew-1.text: Why's the gym still charging me? I stopped going in March.

dyb-auto-renew-2.text: Did you actually cancel, though? Those contracts auto-renew unless you give thirty days' notice.

dyb-auto-renew-3.text: Hang on, so not going isn't cancelling?

dyb-bins-1.text: Evening. Sorry to bother you, but your trash cans have been out on the curb since Tuesday.

dyb-bins-2.text: Oh, have they? Pickup's Thursday, isn't it?

dyb-bins-3.text: It moved to Monday last month. There was a notice.

dyb-blocked-1.text: Quick update. I'm done with the login page, just waiting on design for the icons.

dyb-blocked-2.text: Same boat, sort of. I can't test payments till the API keys come through.

dyb-blocked-3.text: Who's following up on the keys? Because that's blocking both of us now.

dyb-blood-pressure-1.text: Your blood pressure's a little on the high side. Not dangerous, but I'd like to keep an eye on it.

dyb-blood-pressure-2.text: So do I need to start taking something?

dyb-blood-pressure-3.text: Not yet. Cut back on salt, walk a little more, and we'll recheck in three months.

dyb-check-in-photos-1.text: So when do I get my deposit back?

dyb-check-in-photos-2.text: Within thirty days, minus cleaning. And the wall where the shelf was, that'll need patching.

dyb-check-in-photos-3.text: The shelf was there when I moved in, though. It's in the move-in photos.

dyb-four-days-1.text: Have you heard? They want us in the office four days a week from January.

dyb-four-days-2.text: Four? I moved to Kamakura because they said remote was permanent.

dyb-four-days-3.text: I know. Apparently 'permanent' meant 'until further notice'.

dyb-good-and-bad-1.text: So, good news and bad news. The good news is the leak's fixed.

dyb-good-and-bad-3.text: The floor underneath is rotten, so we're lookin' at another week and about two grand.

dyb-kanazawa-1.text: We were gonna do Yosemite in July, but everyone says the valley's bumper-to-bumper.

dyb-kanazawa-2.text: It is. Have you thought about Sequoia? Similar feel, a fraction of the crowds.

dyb-kanazawa-3.text: Ooh. And that's an easy drive from LA, isn't it?

dyb-near-your-folks-1.text: Should I take the job in Singapore? The money's way better.

dyb-near-your-folks-2.text: I mean, I'd never tell you what to do. But you did say you wanted to be near your folks.

dyb-out-of-time-1.text: Sorry to cut in, but we've got five minutes left and we haven't touched the budget.

dyb-out-of-time-2.text: Fair point. Can we give it ten minutes at the start of Thursday's call?

dyb-out-of-time-3.text: Works for me, as long as finance can join.

dyb-potato-1.text: Honestly, half our team could be replaced by AI in five years.

dyb-potato-2.text: Replaced? Or just doing different work?

dyb-potato-3.text: Potato, potahto. Either way, nobody's job looks the same.

dyb-put-a-date-1.text: I've taken on the Chicago account and the new hires. I'd like to talk about my salary.

dyb-put-a-date-2.text: I hear ya. Budgets are tight this year, but lemme see what I can do before the review.

dyb-put-a-date-3.text: I appreciate that. Could we put a date on it?

dyb-residence-card-1.text: I'm here to renew my residence card. Is it just this form?

dyb-residence-card-2.text: That one, your passport, a photo, and proof of employment. Did you book online?

dyb-residence-card-3.text: Book? I didn't realize you had to.

dyb-residence-card-4.text: You don't, strictly, but walk-ins can wait two hours or more.

dyb-rough-on-1.text: Okay, the total's three-twelve, and Jess only had a salad.

dyb-rough-on-2.text: So do we split it evenly or figure out who had what?

dyb-rough-on-3.text: Evenly's easier, but it feels kind of rough on Jess.

dyb-scope-creep-1.text: While you're at it, could you also add a booking page? Should be quick, right?

dyb-scope-creep-2.text: Happy to, but that's outside the original scope, so it'd be a separate quote.

dyb-scope-creep-3.text: Ah. Roughly what are we talking?

dyb-scope-creep-4.text: Ballpark, another three or four days' work. I'll send something over tonight.

dyb-ship-network-1.text: There's a twenty-three thousand yen roaming charge on my bill, and I had data roaming turned off.

dyb-ship-network-2.text: I see it. It looks like your phone connected to a ship network on the ferry.

dyb-ship-network-3.text: A ship network? Nobody mentioned that.

dyb-ship-network-4.text: It happens a lot. I can waive it this time, as a one-time thing.

dyb-side-income-1.text: Do I need to file a tax return if my company already does the year-end adjustment?

dyb-side-income-2.text: Not usually, unless you had side income over two hundred thousand yen.

dyb-side-income-3.text: Ah. My weekend coaching made about three hundred thousand.

dyb-steer-clear-1.text: Can I take these with the antibiotics I'm on?

dyb-steer-clear-2.text: Should be fine, but leave a couple of hours between them, and steer clear of alcohol till the course is done.

dyb-steer-clear-3.text: Not even one beer on the weekend?

dyb-supervisor-1.text: I've been on hold for forty minutes, and now you're telling me you can't issue a refund?

dyb-supervisor-2.text: I completely understand your frustration. What I can do is escalate it to a supervisor today.

dyb-supervisor-3.text: And how long will that take, realistically?

dyb-under-promise-1.text: The deck is solid. My only worry is the timeline slide. It's promising a lot.

dyb-under-promise-3.text: Let's just say I'd rather under-promise and over-deliver.

fn-allergy-salad-1.text: Any allergies at the table I should know about?

fn-allergy-salad-2.text: Yeah, I'm allergic ta tree nuts. Does the chicken salad have nuts innit?

fn-allergy-salad-3.text: It comes with candied pecans, but I can leave 'em off. Oh, actually, no. The dressing has walnuts too. I'd go with the grilled chicken instead.

fn-dessert-split-1.text: Dessert? They have a chocolate lava cake.

fn-dessert-split-2.text: Ugh, I shouldn't... Okay, but only if we splid it.

fn-fast-m-italian.text: I mean, I'm goodwith whatever, but if we're doin' Italian again, I'm gonna lose it.

fn-fast-m-peanut.text: So that comes with a peanut sauce, but if you're allergic, I can todally sub in the ginger dressing, no charge.

fn-fast-n-share.text: Okay, so it's a hundred thirty-two total. Kid Cat only had a salad, so he's eighteen, an' the rest of us split the other hundred fourteen. That's thirty-eight each.

fn-fast-no-sushi-1.text: Okay, whaddaya feel like, sushi or Mexican?

fn-fast-no-sushi-2.text: Honestly, I'm goodwith whatever. Wait, no, not sushi. I had it fer lunch.

fn-fast-no-sushi-3.text: Mexican, then. Oh, but Kid Cat's allergic ta... no, that's nuts. Mexican's fine.

fn-fast-no-sushi-4.text: Mexican it is. I'll grab us a table.

fn-fast-r-specials.text: You guys ready ta order, or wan' me ta go over the specials again?

fn-fast-veggie-1.text: Couldai get the burger, but with the veggie patty?

fn-fast-veggie-2.text: Sure! It comes with fries, or ya can sub a side salad fer a dollar extra.

fn-garlic-wings-1.text: Wanna get the spicy wings ta share?

fn-garlic-wings-2.text: Ooh, I can't do spicy. Can we get the garlic ones instead?

fn-garlic-wings-3.text: Sure. Garlic wings an'... the nachos?

fn-m-almost-out.text: The special tonight is the short ribs, but honestly, we're almost out, so I'd decide preddy quick.

fn-m-cant-do.text: Oh, I can't do dairy, so couldja get the tacos with no cheese an' no sour cream?

fn-m-mood.text: I'm not really in the mood fer anything heavy. Maybe just a salad or somethin'.

fn-m-not-sushi.text: I mean, I'm good with whatever. I'm just not in the mood fer sushi again.

fn-m-share.text: How 'bout we just share a few plates? Then nobody has ta pick.

fn-n-split.text: Okay, it's eighty-four with tip, so split four ways, that's twenty-one each.

fn-n-tip.text: The bill's ninety-six, so with the tip, let's call it a hundred fifteen. That's twenty-three each.

fn-n-wait.text: It's about a forty-minute wait for a table inside, or fifteen if ya don't mind the patio.

fn-order-pasta-1.text: Are you guys ready, or d'you need a minute?

fn-order-pasta-2.text: I think we're ready. Does the minestrone have meat innit?

fn-order-pasta-3.text: It's made with chicken stock, so yeah. But the marinara pasta doesn't, and it's really good.

fn-order-pasta-4.text: Okay, I'll do the pasta. An' could we share a few plates? The bruschetta an' the grilled veggies.

fn-pick-place-1.text: Okay, I'm starvin'. Whaddaya feel like? Thai? Pizza?

fn-pick-place-2.text: Hmm, I'm good with whatever. Just nothing too heavy.

fn-pick-place-3.text: That's not helpful! Okay, whaddabout that tapas place? We could share a few plates.

fn-pick-place-4.text: Ooh, yes. Small plates. I'm in.

fn-r-feel-like.text: So, whaddaya feel like? I'm kinda in the mood fer burgers.

fn-r-nuts.text: So the special tonight is the pesto chicken. Any allergies I should know about?

fn-r-share.text: Wanna just share some plates? Like, three or four things fer the table?

fn-r-whatever.text: Honestly, I'm good with whatever. You pick!

fn-special-pesto-1.text: Hi, guys! So the special tonight is a grilled salmon with a pesto sauce.

fn-special-pesto-2.text: Ooh. Does the pesto have nuts innit?

fn-special-pesto-3.text: It does, yeah. Pine nuts. But I can do it withoud the sauce.

ho-ambitious.text: It's certainly an ambitious timeline. I'd love to see the plan behind it.

ho-anchoring.text: In one study, people spun a wheel that landed on ten or sixty-five, then guessed how many countries in Africa were in the U N. Those who saw sixty-five guessed far higher. The number was random, and still it stuck.

ho-and-then.text: So the data looked great. Engagement up, costs down, everyone happy. And then we actually talked to the users.

ho-bite-bullet.text: 'Bite the bullet' supposedly comes from soldiers biting on a bullet during surgery, though historians are, let's say, skeptical.

ho-bright-start.text: So, a bright start for most of us tomorrow. Make the most of it, though, because by the afternoon…

ho-bulletin-correction.text: And a correction to an earlier report: the new bridge opens in March, not May as we reported, though the toll still hasn't been set.

ho-callin-line.text: Next up on the postgame show, Denise on the line from Phoenix, and she wants to talk bullpen. Denise, you're on the air. Denise? I think we lost her.

ho-catch-22.text: It's a classic Catch twenty-two: you need experience to get the job, and you need the job to get experience.

ho-cautiously.text: I'm cautiously optimistic, with the emphasis on 'cautiously'.

ho-changed-mind.text: I'll be honest, I came into this study expecting to prove the opposite. The data changed my mind, and that's not a sentence I say lightly.

ho-character-building.text: Moving to a country where I didn't speak the language, with two toddlers, in winter, was, let's say, character-building.

ho-chef-miss.text: Do I miss the restaurant? I miss the food. I don't miss the eighteen-hour days, and I definitely don't miss the landlord.

ho-city-growth.text: In nineteen hundred, one person in eight lived in a city. Today it's more than half, and by twenty fifty, if current trends hold, it'll be closer to seven in ten.

ho-coal-town.text: And so the town that built its fortune on coal now markets itself as a destination for clean mountain air.

ho-coffee-wealth.text: Now, people who drink more coffee do tend to live longer. But before you order a third cup, remember that coffee drinkers also tend to be wealthier.

ho-cohost-recap.text: Oh, sure, 'cause your last 'quick five-minute recap' ran twenty-five minutes.

ho-come-in.text: Sorry, can I jump in here? Because you've said twice now that the numbers don't matter.

ho-couldnt-agree.text: I couldn't agree more, actually, which I know will surprise everyone here.

ho-data-cant.text: The data can't tell us whether the policy actually caused the drop.

ho-decreased.text: Ticket sales decreased sharply over the summer, the festival says.

ho-devastating.text: Your novel's been called 'quietly devastating'. Is that how you'd describe it?

ho-dj-rain.text: And that was the third song about rain in a row, which, given the forecast, is either very clever programming or a cry for help.

ho-doc-too-long.text: The doc's great, but it's ninety minutes and the slot's an hour.

ho-door-button.text: Why do elevator 'door close' buttons often do nothing? In many buildings they're disabled, so the doors stay open long enough for wheelchair users. The button stays because pressing it makes us feel in control.

ho-elephant.text: Should we address the elephant in the room? We're forty grand over budget.

ho-empire.text: At its height, around A D one seventeen, the Roman Empire covered nearly two million square miles and perhaps a fifth of the world's population.

ho-exports.text: Exports rose for a third month in a row, helped by a weaker currency.

ho-failure-rent.text: I used to think failure was the opposite of success. Now I think it's more like the rent you pay to get there.

ho-fare.text: Starting April first, the base fare rises from two seventy-five to two ninety, the first increase in six years.

lg-hama-ask-the-way-18.text: Is the temple open now? It's almost four.

lg-hama-ask-the-way-21.text: You can see it from the temple. It's across the river.

lg-hama-ask-the-way-24.text: Nice. The river is very pretty at night.

lg-hama-ask-the-way-25.text: Thank you so much for your help.

lg-hama-hotel-morning-7.text: Let me check. Can I have your room number, please?

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-22.text: That's fine. You can have my other half.

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-23.text: Deal. Does it get busy around noon?

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-24.text: A little, but they're fast. We'll be back before one, for sure.

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-25.text: Okay, let me grab my wallet. Do they take cards?

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-26.text: No, it's cash only. Do you have any cash?

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-27.text: Hmm, I'm almost out. Can we stop at the convenience store on the way?

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-28.text: Sure. There's one on the way.

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-3.text: How about the ramen place on the corner? The pork ramen is amazing.

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-4.text: Ramen sounds great... It's just that I'm trying to eat a little lighter this month.

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-5.text: Oh, right. You started that diet last week, didn't you?

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-6.text: Yeah. I signed up for a half marathon in March, so I'm being careful.

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-7.text: A half marathon? Wow. Okay, so no ramen.

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-8.text: I mean, I could just get a small bowl.

lg-kawa-diet-lunch-9.text: Come on, you never get a small bowl.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-1.text: Oh, hi! You're in three-oh-two, right? I've got something for you.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-10.text: I think there was a second one. He said it needs to be kept cold.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-11.text: Oh! That must be the fish from my parents in Hokkaido.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-12.text: Fish? Then you don't want to leave that sitting around.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-13.text: No, definitely not. Let me look at the slip.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-14.text: Okay, it says they can bring it again tonight or tomorrow.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-15.text: You can just scan the code on the slip and pick a time.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-16.text: Oh, that's easy. Let's see, the latest time today is seven to nine.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-17.text: That works, if you're home by then.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-18.text: I'm home now, so seven to nine is perfect.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-19.text: They usually call you about ten minutes before they come.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-2.text: Hi! Yes, that's my place. Is that for me?

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-20.text: Good. Then I can take a quick shower first.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-21.text: Great. Then you'll have fresh fish for the weekend.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-22.text: If there's a lot, I'll bring some over for you.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-23.text: You don't have to, but I wouldn't say no.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-24.text: It's the least I can do. You took care of my box.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-25.text: Anytime. I work from home most days, so I'm happy to help.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-26.text: Thanks. I'll book the delivery right now, before I forget.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-27.text: Good idea. Have a good night, and enjoy the fish.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-3.text: A delivery driver came by this afternoon, and nobody was home at your place.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-4.text: So he asked me to hold this box for you. I hope that's okay.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-5.text: Of course! Thank you so much. I was at work all day, and I just got home.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-6.text: No problem. It's pretty heavy, though. Do you want me to carry it up?

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-7.text: That's kind of you, but I can manage. It's only one floor.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-8.text: Okay. Oh, and he left a slip on your door, too. It's a yellow one.

lg-kawa-neighbor-parcel-9.text: A slip? But you have the box.

lg-kawa-party-invite-1.text: Julian! I'm glad I caught you. Are you free on Saturday the fourteenth?

lg-kawa-party-invite-10.text: Okay. The thing is, I have a friend's wedding that day in Yokohama.

lg-kawa-party-invite-11.text: Oh no. When does that finish?

lg-kawa-party-invite-12.text: The dinner part ends at seven, I think. I could head over after that.

lg-kawa-party-invite-13.text: That's fine! We'll probably keep going until eleven or so.

lg-kawa-party-invite-14.text: Then I'll come, but it'll be around eight-thirty.

lg-kawa-party-invite-15.text: Perfect. Oh, and can you bring something?

lg-kawa-party-invite-16.text: Sure. Just so you know, though, I'm not a great cook.

lg-kawa-party-invite-18.text: Don't worry, a few people are making food. Drinks would be great.

lg-kawa-party-invite-19.text: Drinks I can do. Is it okay if I bring my sister? She just moved to Tokyo.

lg-kawa-party-invite-20.text: Of course! The more, the better. What's her name?

lg-kawa-party-invite-21.text: Kiki. She doesn't know many people here yet.

lg-kawa-party-invite-22.text: Then she should definitely come. One more thing: please take your shoes off at the door.

lg-kawa-party-invite-24.text: I'll send it to you tonight, with a map. The building is behind a big bakery.

lg-kawa-party-invite-25.text: Behind a bakery. That's easy to remember, and I'll probably buy some bread.

lg-kawa-party-invite-26.text: And it's on the fourth floor, but there's no elevator. Sorry!

lg-kawa-party-invite-27.text: That's okay. I'll text you when I leave Yokohama, so you know when to expect us.

lg-kawa-party-invite-28.text: Great. I'm so happy you can come!

lg-kawa-party-invite-3.text: I finally moved into my new place, so I'm having a housewarming party.

lg-kawa-party-invite-4.text: That's great news! Where is it?

lg-kawa-party-invite-5.text: It's in Shimokitazawa, about five minutes from the station.

lg-kawa-party-invite-6.text: Oh, that's a nice area, with lots of little cafés. What time does it start?

lg-kawa-party-invite-7.text: Around six. People can come and go, so there's no need to be on time.

lg-kawa-party-invite-8.text: Is it a big party? How many people are coming?

lg-kawa-party-invite-9.text: About fifteen, I think. Mostly friends from work and from my old neighborhood.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-1.text: Hey, Dom. Do you have a minute? It's about Friday.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-10.text: Thanks for understanding. I'm only there for one night, so I'm back on Saturday.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-11.text: Can we move dinner? I'm free Saturday night or Sunday.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-12.text: Saturday night could work. When does your flight get in?

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-13.text: Around six, if it's on time.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-14.text: Then let's say eight. That gives you time to drop off your bags at home.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-15.text: Eight on Saturday... Okay, I'll try to make it. But I'll probably be pretty tired.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-16.text: Hmm. That doesn't really sound like a yes.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-17.text: Honestly? If I go out late after a work trip, I'll fall asleep at the table.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-18.text: Ha. Okay, so not Saturday. What about Sunday?

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-19.text: Sunday is much better. Could we do lunch instead of dinner?

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-2.text: Sure. What's up? Is everything okay?

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-20.text: Sure. I think they open at eleven-thirty on weekends.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-21.text: Let's meet at noon, then. It's quieter before the lunch rush.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-22.text: Good. I'll call them and change the booking right after this.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-23.text: Thank you. And lunch is on me this time, because I'm the one who canceled.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-24.text: You don't have to do that.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-26.text: Okay, okay. If they don't have a table at noon, I'll text you a new time.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-27.text: Perfect. I'll keep my phone on.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-28.text: Have a safe trip, and send me a message when you land.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-29.text: I will. See you on Sunday!

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-3.text: Not really. My boss just asked me to fly to Fukuoka on Friday afternoon.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-4.text: Oh no. So you can't make it to dinner?

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-5.text: I'm so sorry. I was really looking forward to that new Italian place.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-6.text: Me too. I booked the table two weeks ago, because it fills up fast.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-7.text: I know, and I feel terrible about it.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-8.text: Hey, it's not your fault. Work is work.

lg-kawa-replan-dinner-9.text: I won't lie, I'm a little sad. But I get it.

lg-mori-next-friday-1.text: So, I have a surprise. I finally got us a table at that Italian place in Daikanyama.

lg-mori-next-friday-10.text: But today's Monday. To me, next Friday is this Friday, the one coming up.

lg-mori-next-friday-11.text: Really? To me, this Friday is this week, and next Friday is the week after.

lg-mori-next-friday-12.text: Okay, well, either way, it's the fourteenth. And the fourteenth is... hmm.

lg-mori-next-friday-14.text: That's the night of my team's farewell dinner for Sylvia. The one I told you about, who's moving to Fukuoka.

lg-mori-next-friday-15.text: Oh, right. You did tell me. Can you skip it?

lg-mori-next-friday-16.text: I mean, I could, technically. I'm the one who organized it, but sure, I could skip it.

lg-mori-next-friday-17.text: Okay, I can tell that's a no.

lg-mori-next-friday-18.text: It's not a no! It's just... a very uncomfortable yes.

lg-mori-next-friday-19.text: Then let's not do that. What about Saturday, the fifteenth? Our actual anniversary is Sunday anyway.

lg-mori-next-friday-2.text: Wait, the one that's always booked? How did you manage that?

lg-mori-next-friday-20.text: Saturday works. But will they let you move a booking you only got because someone else canceled?

lg-mori-next-friday-21.text: No idea. The website says changes have to be made by phone, at least three days ahead.

lg-mori-next-friday-22.text: So you'd have to call them by Tuesday at the latest.

lg-mori-next-friday-23.text: Actually, they open at noon tomorrow. I'll call them on my lunch break.

lg-mori-next-friday-24.text: Ask for the same time if you can. Seven-thirty is perfect, because I can go home and change first.

lg-mori-next-friday-25.text: Seven-thirty, same table if they have it. Anything else, boss?

lg-mori-next-friday-27.text: Then I'll ask about Sunday. And if that's full too, we keep the fourteenth, and you go to your dinner first.

lg-mori-next-friday-28.text: And come to dessert late? That's actually not a bad plan B.

lg-mori-next-friday-29.text: I'm full of good plans. Just not good at saying which Friday I mean.

lg-mori-next-friday-3.text: Someone canceled, and I happened to be checking the website at the right moment.

lg-mori-next-friday-30.text: From now on, we just say the date. No more this Friday, next Friday.

lg-mori-next-friday-31.text: Deal. So, Saturday the fifteenth, seven-thirty, if they can still fit us in.

lg-mori-next-friday-32.text: And if they ask why we're changing, please don't say it's because you can't count Fridays.

lg-mori-next-friday-33.text: I'll tell them my partner has a very busy social life.

lg-mori-next-friday-34.text: Which is true. And mention that it's our anniversary. Some places bring out a little cake if you ask.

lg-mori-next-friday-35.text: Now who's the one with all the good plans?

lg-mori-next-friday-4.text: I tried for my sister's birthday, and they were booked solid for two months.

lg-mori-next-friday-5.text: I know. I've been refreshing that page every morning for a week.

lg-mori-next-friday-7.text: Next Friday, at seven-thirty. For our anniversary.

lg-mori-next-friday-8.text: This Friday? Oh, perfect, I'm free. I'll leave work early.

lg-mori-next-friday-9.text: No, no, not this Friday. Next Friday. The fourteenth.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-1.text: Okay, I took a look under the sink. Do you want the good news or the bad news first?

lg-mori-plumber-visit-11.text: Her building, her pipes. Every place is a little different.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-13.text: Option one, I clean out the trap and run a snake through the pipe. That's a long metal cable that breaks up the clog.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-14.text: That's eight thousand yen, and I can do it right now. But honestly, it might come back in a few months.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-16.text: Because the pipe itself is old, and the inside is rough, so grease sticks to it easily.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-18.text: I replace the trap and the old pipe behind it. That's eighteen... sorry, no — twenty-two thousand, once you add the parts.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-2.text: The good news, please. It's been a long week.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-20.text: Right. It costs more, but you won't be calling me again next spring.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-21.text: Can you do that one today, too?

lg-mori-plumber-visit-22.text: Not today, unfortunately. The pipe I need is out of stock at the shop, so the earliest would be Thursday.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-23.text: Thursday. Hmm. I really don't want to live with this smell until Thursday.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-24.text: Here's what a lot of people do. I clean the trap today, no charge for the snake, and then I come back Thursday to replace it.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-25.text: So I'd only pay the twenty-two thousand in the end?

lg-mori-plumber-visit-26.text: That's right. Today's visit would just be part of the same job.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-27.text: Okay, let's do that. Thursday morning works for me, if you can come before ten.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-28.text: Nine-thirty it is. And until then, try not to pour any cooking oil down the sink.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-29.text: Where am I supposed to put it, then?

lg-mori-plumber-visit-3.text: The good news is, it's not the main pipe under the floor. That would be a much bigger job.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-30.text: Let it cool, wipe the pan with a paper towel, and throw that out with the burnable trash.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-31.text: That sounds like a lot of paper towels.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-32.text: It is, but paper towels are a lot cheaper than me. Trust me on that one.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-33.text: Got it. And how long will the job take on Thursday?

lg-mori-plumber-visit-34.text: About an hour, maybe less. Just clear out the cabinet under the sink before I get there, so I'm not moving all your cleaning supplies around.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-4.text: Okay, that's a relief. And the bad news?

lg-mori-plumber-visit-5.text: The trap is pretty much full of grease. That's the U-shaped pipe right below the drain.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-6.text: The trap. Is that what's causing the smell?

lg-mori-plumber-visit-7.text: That's the smell, and it's why the water's taking so long to go down.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-8.text: I thought it was the dishwasher. My neighbor said hers did the same thing last year.

lg-mori-plumber-visit-9.text: Could be, in some buildings, but not here. Your dishwasher drains into a different pipe.

lg-mori-rental-key-1.text: Hi there, can you both hear me okay? The internet here is a little slow today.

lg-mori-rental-key-10.text: The listing said checkout was at eleven, I think.

lg-mori-rental-key-11.text: Mm-hm, so the listing is a little out of date, and checkout is actually...

lg-mori-rental-key-12.text: Sorry, Mr. Lopez, I think you're on mute. We can't hear anything.

lg-mori-rental-key-13.text: Oh, sorry about that! My dog started barking, so I muted myself and forgot.

lg-mori-rental-key-14.text: What I was saying is, the listing is old. It used to be eleven, but now checkout is at ten.

lg-mori-rental-key-15.text: But I can push it back to one o'clock for a small fee, if that helps.

lg-mori-rental-key-16.text: A small fee. How small are we talking?

lg-mori-rental-key-17.text: It depends on the day. Usually it's around three thousand yen, but on weekends it's a bit more.

lg-mori-rental-key-18.text: Oh, that's not bad. That would give us the whole morning to pack.

lg-mori-rental-key-19.text: Hang on. A bit more meaning what, exactly?

lg-mori-rental-key-2.text: We can hear you fine. Thanks for doing a video call, by the way.

lg-mori-rental-key-20.text: It's hard to say until I see the other bookings. I'll let you know closer to the date.

lg-mori-rental-key-21.text: Okay. We're leaving on Sunday, though, so it'll be the weekend price. We'll think about it.

lg-mori-rental-key-22.text: Sure, no pressure. Oh, and a heads-up: the heater in the bedroom takes a while to warm up.

lg-mori-rental-key-23.text: Good to know. And if the code doesn't work for some reason, what should we do?

lg-mori-rental-key-24.text: Send me a text instead of calling. I'm at work until seven, and I can't always pick up.

lg-mori-rental-key-25.text: Text, not call. Actually, why don't we text you before we leave the airport, so you know we're on our way?

lg-mori-rental-key-26.text: That would be great. Then I can turn the heater on from my phone, and the house will be warm when you get there.

lg-mori-rental-key-27.text: Oh, you're a lifesaver. We really appreciate it.

lg-mori-rental-key-28.text: My pleasure. And if you want the late checkout, just tell me by Friday.

lg-mori-rental-key-29.text: We will, once we know what a bit more means.

lg-mori-rental-key-3.text: No problem. I like to explain the key box before guests arrive, because it confuses a lot of people.

lg-mori-rental-key-4.text: Great. Our flight lands at four, so we should get to the house around six.

lg-mori-rental-key-5.text: Perfect. So the key box is on the left side of the front door, just under the mailbox.

lg-mori-rental-key-6.text: The code is four, seven, two, nine... wait, no, sorry. That's the old one. It's four, seven, nine, two.

lg-mori-rental-key-7.text: Four, seven, nine, two. Got it, I'm writing it down.

lg-mori-rental-key-8.text: Thanks. I changed it last week, after the cleaner who comes on Mondays lost her copy, and I still mix them up.

lg-mori-rental-key-9.text: Can I ask about checkout? Our flight home isn't until the evening.

lg-mori-taxi-address-1.text: Good evening. Where can I take you tonight?

lg-mori-taxi-address-10.text: Oh, no, wait. I said Garden Court, not Garden Place.

lg-mori-taxi-address-11.text: Ah, I'm sorry. I heard Garden Place, which is the big shopping area. Do you have the address?

lg-mori-taxi-address-12.text: Hold on, I'll call my friend. She can explain it better than I can.

lg-mori-taxi-address-13.text: Hi! Let me guess. You're lost.

lg-mori-taxi-address-14.text: Sort of. The driver heard Garden Place, which I guess is somewhere else.

lg-mori-taxi-address-15.text: Don't worry, it's close. Tell him we're behind the old post office, on the street with the bakery.

lg-mori-taxi-address-16.text: Okay, apparently it's on the bakery street, just behind that old post office.

lg-mori-taxi-address-17.text: The post office on Komazawa Street? I know it. That's only about five minutes from here.

lg-mori-taxi-address-18.text: Oh, good. Sorry, I should have shown you the address in the first place.

lg-mori-taxi-address-19.text: Not at all. The two names sound almost the same, and it happens more often than you'd think.

lg-mori-taxi-address-2.text: Hi. Garden Court in Ebisu, please. It's an apartment building near the park.

lg-mori-taxi-address-20.text: Will it cost a lot more? I'm not complaining, I'm just curious.

lg-mori-taxi-address-21.text: Maybe five or six hundred yen. But since it was my mistake, I'll stop the meter when we reach the post office.

lg-mori-taxi-address-22.text: Oh, you really don't have to do that.

lg-mori-taxi-address-23.text: It's fine. From there, could you guide me? Those little side streets are hard to find at night.

lg-mori-taxi-address-24.text: Sure. My friend told me to turn left at the bakery and look for a white building.

lg-mori-taxi-address-25.text: Here's the post office, and there's the bakery. Left here, you said?

lg-mori-taxi-address-26.text: Yes, left. And that's the white building, and there she is, waving at us.

lg-mori-taxi-address-27.text: Then here we are. That comes to two thousand eight hundred yen.

lg-mori-taxi-address-28.text: Here's my card. Thank you so much for being so patient with me.

lg-mori-taxi-address-29.text: My pleasure. And next time, just show the driver the address on your phone. Most of my foreign passengers do, and it saves everyone a lot of trouble.

lg-mori-taxi-address-3.text: Garden Place in Ebisu. Sure, that's about fifteen minutes from here.

lg-mori-taxi-address-30.text: Lesson learned. Have a good night!

lg-mori-taxi-address-4.text: Great. I'm meeting a friend for dinner, and I'm already running a little late.

lg-mori-taxi-address-5.text: Traffic isn't too bad tonight, so we should make good time.

lg-mori-taxi-address-6.text: Is it okay if I pay by card? I only have a few thousand yen in cash.

lg-mori-taxi-address-7.text: Card is fine. You can tap it on the screen on the back of my seat.

lg-mori-taxi-address-8.text: Sorry, are we close? The map on my phone says we're going the wrong way.

lg-mori-taxi-address-9.text: We're almost there. Garden Place is just past the next light, on the right.

lg-yama-barbecue-1.text: Okay, these are done. Who wants the ones that are only slightly burned?

lg-yama-barbecue-10.text: No, the concert thing turned out to be nothing. The extra ticket was her brother's, and he got sick.

lg-yama-barbecue-11.text: Not Tangy. Think about who showed up today in the same car as him.

lg-yama-barbecue-12.text: That was Pekoe. But she lives near him, so that doesn't really prove anything.

lg-yama-barbecue-13.text: Okay, but here's the thing. Last week, Lucky brought cupcakes to work and claimed he made them himself.

lg-yama-barbecue-14.text: Lucky? The guy who once set off the smoke alarm making toast?

lg-yama-barbecue-15.text: That's the guy. And they had that little paper flag on top, the kind they use at Pekoe's bakery.

lg-yama-barbecue-16.text: So either he's taking baking lessons from her, or he's trying really hard to impress somebody.

lg-yama-barbecue-17.text: Or both. Honestly, that's a long shot, but I'll admit it's not nothing.

lg-yama-barbecue-18.text: Also, last Friday he asked me if I knew any good bakeries. He lives above one. Why would he need another bakery?

lg-yama-barbecue-19.text: Unless it's a very specific bakery.

lg-yama-barbecue-2.text: Slightly is generous. That one's basically charcoal.

lg-yama-barbecue-20.text: Okay, that one's a little suspicious.

lg-yama-barbecue-21.text: Wait, wait, stop talking. They're coming back. Act normal.

lg-yama-barbecue-23.text: That's the least normal thing anyone's ever said.

lg-yama-barbecue-24.text: Okay, they're carrying one small bag of ice between them. One bag. For twenty minutes.

lg-yama-barbecue-25.text: And look who's holding it. She didn't even go to the store with him, supposedly.

lg-yama-barbecue-26.text: Okay, fine, I'm convinced. So do we say something, or do we let them tell us when they're ready?

lg-yama-barbecue-27.text: We let them tell us. If we push, Lucky will just put it off for another six months out of pure stubbornness.

lg-yama-barbecue-28.text: Six months? He took a year to tell us he'd changed jobs.

lg-yama-barbecue-29.text: And we only found out because his new badge fell out of his wallet.

lg-yama-barbecue-3.text: I'll take it. Hey, did you guys notice Lucky left again?

lg-yama-barbecue-30.text: Fine. But I'm putting him next to her for the photo. That's not pushing. That's just good composition.

lg-yama-barbecue-31.text: You're a terrible person, and I love it. Hey, Lucky! Did they run out of ice at the first three stores?

lg-yama-barbecue-32.text: Static! You literally just agreed not to push.

lg-yama-barbecue-33.text: That wasn't pushing. That was a perfectly innocent question about ice.

lg-yama-barbecue-34.text: Look at his face, though. He's turning the same color as the sausages.

lg-yama-barbecue-35.text: And Pekoe's suddenly very interested in the grill.

lg-yama-barbecue-36.text: She's been reading the same sauce bottle for a full minute.

lg-yama-barbecue-37.text: Okay, I'll back off. For now. But for the record, I said it was a long shot, and I was wrong.

lg-yama-barbecue-4.text: Again? That's the third time. Where does he keep going?

lg-yama-barbecue-5.text: He said he was getting more ice, but the convenience store is like two minutes away, and he's been gone for twenty.

lg-yama-barbecue-6.text: Maybe he's really picky about ice.

lg-yama-barbecue-7.text: Or maybe it's not ice he's after.

lg-yama-barbecue-8.text: Right? And did you see who left right before him? Both times?

lg-yama-barbecue-9.text: Hold on, you're not saying Tangy. Everyone already thinks it's Tangy, ever since that concert.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-1.text: Okay, so I found two places for the weekend, and I need you both to actually pick one this time.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-10.text: Honestly, I'm easy. Whatever you guys want.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-11.text: You always say that, and then you complain about the price afterwards.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-12.text: I don't complain. I just... mention it. Out loud. A few times.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-13.text: So the inn's too much for you.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-14.text: I mean, it's not that it's too much. It's just, it's a lot for one night, you know?

lg-yama-onsen-plan-15.text: That's literally what too much means.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-16.text: Okay, what if we skip the dinner at the inn? Then it drops to about seventeen thousand.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-18.text: Wait, but where would we eat? It's up in the hills, right? Is there anything nearby?

lg-yama-onsen-plan-19.text: Let me look. Um... there's one soba place, and it closes at seven-thirty.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-20.text: Seven-thirty. So we'd have to check in, bathe, and eat, all before seven-thirty.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-21.text: That sounds less like a vacation and more like a race.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-22.text: Okay, fine. So it's the full inn with dinner, or the business hotel.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-23.text: I'll be honest, I'd rather pay more and not think about it. The whole point is to relax.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-24.text: ...Yeah. Okay, that's fair. If I'm gonna spend the money, I want the dinner and the bath.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-25.text: So the inn, with dinner. Everyone agrees?

lg-yama-onsen-plan-27.text: Yes. But I'm driving, so I get to pick the music.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-29.text: Nothing from the eighties this time. We heard the same album four times last trip.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-3.text: You picked a karaoke place that closed at nine.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-30.text: Five times. And you both sang along.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-31.text: Okay, one problem. The inn only has a room for Saturday. Friday's full.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-32.text: Saturday works for me. I've got that thing Friday night anyway.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-33.text: Saturday's fine. Can we leave early, though? Like, eight? I want to stop at the lake on the way.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-34.text: Eight is early, but sure. I'll pick you both up.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-35.text: Great. I'm booking it right now, before anyone changes their mind.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-36.text: Wait, does the private bath cost extra, or is it included?

lg-yama-onsen-plan-37.text: It's included, but you have to reserve a time slot when you check in. They go fast, apparently.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-39.text: The reviews say the evening slots are usually gone by four, so whoever gets there first signs us up.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-40.text: Then we should get there by three, not stop at every lake on the way.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-41.text: One lake. I said one lake.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-42.text: Okay, it's booked. Saturday night, three people, dinner included. Nobody's allowed to cancel.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-43.text: I wasn't going to cancel. I was going to mention the price. Once. Quietly.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-5.text: Anyway. Option one is a small inn up in the hills. Private outdoor bath, dinner included, about twenty-two thousand yen each.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-7.text: Option two is a business hotel by the station. Fourteen thousand, no dinner, but there's a public bath across the street.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-8.text: A business hotel. For our big relaxing weekend away. Sounds magical.

lg-yama-onsen-plan-9.text: It's clean, it's cheap, and it's two minutes from the station. I'm just laying out the options.

lg-yama-radio-callin-1.text: And we're back. It's a quarter past midnight, and the phones have been lighting up. Apollo, who've we got?

lg-yama-radio-callin-10.text: The next one was at seven the next morning. And this was a tiny town, so no taxis, nothing.

lg-yama-radio-callin-11.text: So what did you do, sleep at the bus stop?

lg-yama-radio-callin-12.text: I was about to, honestly. Then this old farmer pulls up in a truck full of potatoes and asks if I'm okay.

lg-yama-radio-callin-14.text: No, not a word of English, and my Japanese at the time was, let's say, a work in progress.

lg-yama-radio-callin-15.text: That's a polite way of putting it.

lg-yama-radio-callin-16.text: So I just showed him the guesthouse on my phone, and he nodded, and moved a sack of potatoes so I could sit down.

lg-yama-radio-callin-17.text: Riding shotgun with the potatoes. I like it.

lg-yama-radio-callin-18.text: And it was forty minutes away! In the opposite direction from his farm. He wouldn't take any money, either.

lg-yama-radio-callin-19.text: Forty minutes out of his way, at night, for a stranger with a backpack.

lg-yama-radio-callin-2.text: We've got Tammy, calling from a rest stop somewhere in Hokkaido, if the line holds up.

lg-yama-radio-callin-20.text: And he talked the whole way. I understood maybe one word in ten, but I nodded a lot.

lg-yama-radio-callin-22.text: So the disaster turned out to be the best part of the trip.

lg-yama-radio-callin-23.text: Pretty much. The next morning, he dropped off a bag of potatoes at the guesthouse with a note that said—

lg-yama-radio-callin-24.text: Oh, no, not now. Tammy? What did the note say?

lg-yama-radio-callin-25.text: Sorry, I'm back. It said, "Next time, run faster."

lg-yama-radio-callin-26.text: Ha! A farmer and a comedian.

lg-yama-radio-callin-27.text: So that's why I'm calling. I'm stopping at his farm tomorrow to say thanks, and I was hoping you'd play something for him.

lg-yama-radio-callin-28.text: Does he even listen to the show? It's past midnight.

lg-yama-radio-callin-29.text: Probably not. Farmers go to bed at like eight. But I'll know, and I'll tell him.

lg-yama-radio-callin-3.text: Tammy, welcome to the show. You're up late.

lg-yama-radio-callin-30.text: So what are you bringing him?

lg-yama-radio-callin-31.text: A box of chocolates from Sapporo, and a photo of me catching my bus this morning. Proof that I learned.

lg-yama-radio-callin-32.text: That's good enough for me. Tammy, drive safe, and say hi to the potatoes.

lg-yama-radio-callin-33.text: And for everyone else still on the road tonight, pull over if you're getting sleepy. The rest stops up there are open all night.

lg-yama-radio-callin-34.text: Wise words from a man who once fell asleep in the middle of his own show.

lg-yama-radio-callin-35.text: That was one time, and the song was nine minutes long.

lg-yama-radio-callin-36.text: Excuses, excuses. Anyway, this one goes out to a farmer in Hokkaido who's definitely asleep.

lg-yama-radio-callin-4.text: Hi! Yeah, I'm driving to Furano for the lavender, and I pulled over because I heard you asking for travel disasters.

lg-yama-radio-callin-6.text: So, two years ago I was backpacking up here, and I missed the last bus to my guesthouse by—

lg-yama-radio-callin-7.text: Tammy, you broke up there. You missed the bus by how much?

lg-yama-radio-callin-8.text: Sorry! By one minute. I could literally see its taillights going around the corner.

lg-yama-rental-counter-1.text: Hi there, welcome to Maui! Do you folks have a reservation with us tonight?

lg-yama-rental-counter-10.text: Thirty-five a day? That's half of what we're paying for the car.

lg-yama-rental-counter-11.text: It's not cheap, I won't lie. But the road up to Haleakala is pretty narrow, and people do scrape a mirror now and then.

lg-yama-rental-counter-12.text: Hang on, doesn't my credit card cover rental cars? I'm almost sure it does.

lg-yama-rental-counter-13.text: A lot of cards do, but usually as secondary coverage, meaning your own car insurance pays first. You might want to double-check.

lg-yama-rental-counter-14.text: Sure, let me just double-check that from a rental counter in Maui at nine at night.

lg-yama-rental-counter-15.text: Actually, I've got the app. Give me a second.

lg-yama-rental-counter-16.text: Okay. It says primary coverage, up to thirty-one days, as long as I pay with this card and turn down the rental company's damage waiver.

lg-yama-rental-counter-17.text: Then it sounds like you're in good shape. I'll just need you to initial here that you're declining.

lg-yama-rental-counter-18.text: Wait, so if we'd said yes to your package, his card wouldn't have covered anything?

lg-yama-rental-counter-19.text: That's how most of those card programs work, yeah. It's one or the other.

lg-yama-rental-counter-2.text: We do. It should be under Sherb. A compact, for five days.

lg-yama-rental-counter-20.text: Funny how that didn't come up a minute ago.

lg-yama-rental-counter-21.text: Well, I'm not really supposed to give insurance advice, so...

lg-yama-rental-counter-22.text: Understood. What else do we need to know?

lg-yama-rental-counter-23.text: Last thing: there's a two-hundred-dollar hold on the card on top of the rental, and it drops off seven to ten business days after you bring the car back with a full tank.

lg-yama-rental-counter-24.text: Two hundred on top. Okay. And if we bring it back less than full?

lg-yama-rental-counter-25.text: Then there's a refueling charge, and it runs about nine dollars a gallon, so you'll want to stop at the gas station by the airport first.

lg-yama-rental-counter-26.text: Nine dollars. Okay, figure we'll fill up Friday night, then.

lg-yama-rental-counter-27.text: Or Saturday morning, on the way. It's right by the airport.

lg-yama-rental-counter-28.text: Saturday morning, when we have to be here by noon, and you've never been on time for anything in your life.

lg-yama-rental-counter-3.text: Got it right here. Compact, five days, and you're dropping it off Saturday by noon.

lg-yama-rental-counter-30.text: Smart move. You're in row C, spot fourteen. Snap a few photos of any scratches before you drive off, so they're on record.

lg-yama-rental-counter-31.text: Will do. And thanks for, you know, eventually mentioning the card thing.

lg-yama-rental-counter-4.text: Noon? I'm pretty sure we booked it until five.

lg-yama-rental-counter-5.text: Your confirmation says twelve, but I can push it to five for one extra day's charge.

lg-yama-rental-counter-6.text: A whole day's charge for five hours? Hard pass.

lg-yama-rental-counter-7.text: Totally fair. Now, before I print the contract, let's go over coverage real quick.

lg-yama-rental-counter-9.text: So your rate includes the liability the state requires, but that doesn't cover damage to the car itself, which is where our full protection package comes in, at thirty-four ninety-nine a day, and it takes your deductible down to zero.

mu-w-wouldve.text: We would've called ya, but the number on the booking didn't work.

mw-as-i-mentioned.text: As I mentioned in my last email, the deadline was Tuesday.

mw-badge-days.text: Your laptop should arrive in three to five business days. Your badge, another two on top of that.

mw-ballpark.text: Could you give me a ballpark figure? Nothing set in stone, just roughly.

mw-bandwidth.text: Do you have the bandwidth to take on the Nagoya account this quarter?

mw-been-meaning.text: I've been meanin' to ask ya about your trip.

mw-bit-much.text: Proposing at her work party? I mean, it's your call, but it might be a bit much.

mw-bring-anything.text: Can I bring anything on Saturday?

mw-came-out-wrong.text: Oh wow, you look way better than your photos! Sorry, that came out wrong.

mw-circle-back.text: Great question. Let's, uh, circle back to that once we've got more data.

mw-close-the-door.text: Could you stop by my office when you get a minute? And close the door behind you.

mw-cold-feet.text: Dude, I think he's getting cold feet about the wedding.

mw-couldja.text: Couldja just send me the link again?

mw-cup-of-tea.text: Jazz? It's not really my cup of tea, but I'll come along for the company.

mw-didncha.text: Didncha say you'd already booked it?

mw-each-to-their-own.text: Pineapple and blue cheese? Well, to each their own, I guess.

mw-extension.text: My direct line's three-one-two, five-five-five, oh-one-four-seven, or just call the front desk and ask for extension thirty-eight.

mw-fair-and-square.text: You beat me fair and square. Rematch next Sunday?

mw-fortnight.text: My in-laws are coming for Thanksgiving. For ten days. Ten whole days.

mw-fresh-eyes.text: It might be worth having someone with fresh eyes go over the figures.
